# Senior Product Manager

**Hybrid**Product and Engineering

London, England, United Kingdom

## Description

**We're on a mission to make banking 10x better.**

At 10x Banking ("ten-*ex*banking") we're transforming the financial industry with our cloud-native core banking platform. 10x's platform powers global banks and financial institutions including Chase UK, Old Mutual and Westpac.

We offer a diverse, global community that thrives on innovation and collaboration. Tackling exciting challenges with the utmost integrity, we aim to make a positive impact through our work for our clients, their customers and the communities we work in.

Be part of something bigger - join us and transform and industry.

**About the role**

As a Senior Product Manager, you will lead two closely connected product areas within our core banking platform: our foundational core domain services and our migration tooling. The foundational services provide the common model and capabilities through which banks create and manage customers and organisations, financial products, and the accounts that connect them. The migration tooling enables clients to move complex customer, account, product and transaction data from legacy platforms onto 10x safely, efficiently and with confidence.

This is a senior individual contributor role with significant scope and influence. You will set product direction across multiple engineering teams, shape cross-platform architecture and sequencing, and work directly with clients undertaking complex core modernisation programmes. You will be expected to operate comfortably at both strategic and technical depth, turning difficult platform and data problems into clear product outcomes and executable plans.

Our product teams are cross-functional and durable, bringing product and engineering together to deliver measurable customer and business value. You will partner particularly closely with engineering leaders, architects, implementation teams and client technology stakeholders.

**What you will do**

* Own the vision, strategy, outcomes and roadmap for the foundational core domain services and migration tooling, aligning them with 10x product strategy and client needs.

* Lead product work across the teams responsible for parties, products and accounts, creating a coherent and externally understandable platform experience rather than a collection of internal services.

* Define how clients migrate data onto 10x, covering the end-to-end journey from data mapping and preparation through ingestion, validation, reconciliation, rehearsal, cutover and post-migration assurance.

* Work at technical depth with engineers and architects on domain models, APIs, event schemas, data contracts, sequencing, performance, observability, resiliency and operational controls.

* Partner with client technology, data and migration teams to understand source platforms, target operating models, migration risks and integration constraints.

* Set clear product outcomes and make evidence-based trade-offs across platform simplification, migration capability, client commitments, reliability, scalability and time to value.

* Lead discovery for complex and ambiguous problems, combining direct client engagement, technical investigation, operational insight, market context and product analytics.

* Translate strategy and customer problems into clear requirements, hypotheses and delivery increments without prescribing engineering solutions unnecessarily.

* Coordinate dependencies across Product, Engineering, Architecture, Implementation, Support and Commercial teams, resolving ambiguity and driving decisions.

* Act as a trusted senior product representative in client and prospect discussions, explaining platform concepts, migration approaches, trade-offs and roadmap direction credibly to both technical and executive audiences.

* Define measures of success and use data to assess product adoption, migration performance, reliability, client effort and commercial impact.

* Help evolve how product and engineering work at 10x, including the responsible adoption of agentic, AI-assisted product development lifecycle and software development lifecycle practices.

* Coach and influence other product managers, raising the quality of technical product thinking, discovery, documentation and decision-making across the organisation.

**What success looks like**

In your first 12 months, you will:

* Establish a clear strategy, outcome framework and prioritised roadmap across foundational core services and migration tooling.

* Create strong alignment across the teams responsible for parties, products, accounts and migrations, with clear ownership, interfaces and shared outcomes.

* Deepen 10x's ability to support safe, repeatable and scalable client migrations, reducing friction and increasing confidence for both prospects and live clients.

* Drive measurable improvements in the usability, reliability, performance or adoption of the product areas you own.

* Build trusted relationships with engineering, architecture, implementation, client-facing teams and client technology leaders.

* Become a recognised subject matter expert who can represent these product areas with credibility from detailed engineering discussions through to executive and client conversations.

* Make practical progress towards more agentic product and software development practices, demonstrating improvements in quality, speed, traceability or decision-making rather than adopting AI for its own sake.

* Raise the standard of technical product management and cross-team product leadership across 10x.

## Requirements

Ideally, you will have...

* Experience as a Senior Product Manager, Lead Product Manager or equivalent in B2B SaaS, fintech, banking infrastructure or enterprise technology.

* A strong record of setting direction and delivering outcomes for technically complex platform products used by multiple clients, teams or product lines.

* The technical fluency to work credibly with engineers and architects on APIs, event-driven systems, distributed services, data models and cloud-native architectures.

* Experience owning products where data integrity, correctness, scalability, auditability and operational resilience are critical.

* Experience leading multiple related product areas or engineering teams and aligning their work around a coherent strategy and customer outcome.

* Strong product judgement, including the ability to move between long-term platform strategy, detailed technical constraints and immediate client needs.

* Experience working directly with enterprise clients and senior stakeholders through complex implementation or transformation programmes.

* A proven ability to influence across organisational boundaries, make difficult prioritisation decisions and create clarity without relying on formal authority.

* Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to explain complex technical concepts in straightforward commercial and customer language.

* A rigorous approach to discovery, outcome definition, measurement and product decision-making.

We'd especially love to hear from you if you have...

* Hands-on product experience with core banking platforms, banking ledgers, account or product domain models, or other systems of record.
* Led or materially contributed to a core banking migration, or another complex, high-volume data migration between platforms.

**About the role**
As a Software Engineer at 10x, you are passionate about working with cutting-edge technologies, and bring deep technical knowledge and proven experience with data systems to deliver scalable solutions. This role offers deep design and implementation work on complex distributed systems, with exposure to all parts of the banking backend.

In addition to the technical side of the role, you bring experience proven experience in the challenges of delivery of high-quality software in a high-performance and fast paced development environment.

**About you**

You will be keen to solve problems beyond the borders of your immediate team and demonstrate that you can think on multiple levels; from strategic and tactical to driving operational excellence and system availability.

You are adept at reading code and designing and delivering systems that can exceed the exacting demands of our clients.

* Java / Spring Boot ecosystem (and some Kotlin)
* Kubernetes, Docker, Helm, Terraform, AWS
* Kafka, Redis, PostgresSQL, Spring reactive, Quarkus
* Gradle, Jenkins, SonarQube, Checkmarx

## Requirements

* Solid Java software development skillset, ideally utilising Java 21 or higher and the Spring framework, in particular Spring Boot 3.x.x.
* A demonstrable Test-driven-development mindset, with good experience in writing unit, integration, and functional tests specifically for web services.
* Experience with Kafka and event-driven architecture.
* Prior experience working with SQL databases, strong knowledge around PostgreSQL
* A keen interest in Continuous Integration / Continuous Deployment, experience with build tools such as Gradle / Maven.
* A keen interest on development lifecycle process, best practices and operating distributed cloud-based microservices.
* Strong knowledge of designing and building RESTful APIs.
* Experience building and deploying production level Microservices using Docker / Kubernetes / Helm.
* Proven experience developing JVM-based microservices running in Kubernetes, and taking them through all stages of the development life cycle.
* Proven experience building cloud-based solutions using AWS.
* Applicable knowledge of event streaming technologies (e.g. Kafka).
* Excellent communication skills, solid work ethic, and a strong desire to write production-quality code
* Good experience of delivering software in an Agile manner, working as part of a Scrum team.
* You write high quality, clean code that's reliable, maintainable and performant.
* You can assess the technical trade-offs and deliverables needed to create optimal solutions.

## Benefits

At 10x Banking, we believe in empowering you to get the job done! Our benefits are here to support you be the best you can be.

* 25 days of holiday in addition to Bank/Public Holidays (with the option to swap some public holidays for alternative dates such as Diwali or Eid)
* 1 day off on or around your birthday
* 4 wellbeing days (1 additional paid day off per quarter, aimed at supporting you to maintain your personal wellbeing)
* Remote enabled working: scroll down to see the office requirements for this role
* Enhanced parental policies, including time off for fertility treatment
* Regular social gatherings and affinity groups
* Work from anywhere outside your typical working location - up to 4 weeks a year
* Career progression and learning pathways
* 1 paid volunteering day a year
* Sabbatical leave
* Options pool
* Private health insurance, with the option to add your family
* Pension scheme
* Enhanced company sick pay
* Life Assurance

**More about 10x**

We are driven by the belief that whatever we do as a business has to be done in the right way. Our three core values of: Transformation, Integrity and Impact support this.

Discover what life is like at 10x over on Instagram and find out what the company is up to on LinkedIn.

**10x Ways of Working**We recognise that a better work/life balance can improve people's motivation, performance and overall wellbeing. That's why if there's scope in the working day, we have flexibility around our core hours to do the things that matter to you.

We also know some work is done better at home and some is done better in the office, and that a one-size-fits-all approach doesn't enable high performance. That's why 10x is a remote-enabled organisation and supports agile working. **This role has an office attendance requirement of approx. 2 days per quarter**, in agreement with your line manager.

Additionally, everyone comes together at our quarterly 10x Together Days to collaborate, align on strategy, and socialise. As all employees are employed on London-based contracts, commuting costs to the office are covered by employees and not by 10x.

**Equal opportunities for all**

At 10x, we are passionate about our people and are committed to fostering a more diverse and inclusive culture. We are building a community where every 10xer can bring their authentic self to work and feel empowered to reach their full potential. Our many employee networks help amplify this vision.

Alongside assessing technical capabilities to do the role, our assessment process will identify what you can uniquely bring to our 10x teams, and the potential you have to thrive here. Common to every role that 10xers perform, are 3 core competencies that we look for in our future 10xers - **Business Impact**, **Change Driver** & **Delivery Excellence.**

We are committed to ensuring all job applicants are treated equally and fairly and encourage applicants of all ethnicities, race, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, family or parental status, age, neurodiversity or disability status.

# Staff Tech Lead, Web & Developer Products

London, UK (Remote)

Our everyday digital experiences are in the middle of a realtime revolution: chatting alongside a livestream, getting realtime financial updates, or working with colleagues in a shared online space. Consumers now expect realtime as standard, and Ably powers a large part of it.

We put developers first. Our products help teams build, extend, and deliver realtime digital experiences, delivering over 700 billion messages to more than 2 billion devices every month. Teams at HubSpot, Fin, Dialpad, NASCAR, Sportsbet, and General Motors all build on Ably.

Working at Ably means helping build the infrastructure that will shape the next generation of the internet. More of what people do online is becoming live, shared and interactive, which only makes what we build more relevant and more necessary. AI is the latest place that shows up. There's still so much to build, and we'd like your help with it.

## **About this role**

As the Staff Tech Lead for the Developer Experience team at Ably, you’ll report directly to our CTO and co-own the DevEx vision and strategy. You’ll lead the engineering team that owns our customer-facing web platform - our dashboard, documentation platform, and control plane - transforming it into a world-class experience for our users.

You are a senior, hands-on engineer who’s passionate about building for developers like yourself; someone who’ll obsess over the developer journey and elevate the user experience of the Ably platform. You’ll blend deep full-stack expertise with a strong product mindset, and lead a team of engineers working on initiatives where the feedback loop is immediate, because you and your team are the target users of the very ecosystem you are building.

Ably is an AI-forward organisation and this is a leadership role for an AI-first engineer. You must have confident, hands-on experience of AI-assisted development and be able to define how a team actually works with these tools day to day, and tell the difference between genuine leverage and noise.

## **Day to day you will**

* **Obsess over developer experience.** You’ll have broad responsibility for elevating how developers interact with Ably’s platform and services, partnering with the DevEx PM as a unified leadership team to deliver a developer experience that becomes a reference point for the industry.
* **Define and lead on AI-first working practices.** You’ll be the catalyst and standard-setter for AI-enabled development across the team. You’ll leverage LLMs and AI tools to accelerate velocity, design workflows, set the guardrails and coach engineers to use them well - without compromising on engineering integrity.
* **Lead technical execution and vision.** You’ll lead a team of five engineers building customer-facing web applications and own the technical architecture and design decisions for our dashboard, docs platform, marketing website, and billing UI.
* **Drive a product-first engineering culture.** You’ll foster an environment where engineers are themselves principal stakeholders of product features, and obsess over customer outcomes. You’ll challenge the "feature factory" mentality and build a team that takes true ownership of the product.
* **Thrive in a rapid iteration environment.** You’ll operate in a high-velocity workspace where PMs, customers, and engineers co-create features. You’ll lead the team in working full-stack to iterate, improve, and ship improvements quickly.
* **Guide engineering outcomes and quality.** You’ll set and enforce high standards for code review, testing, and production readiness. You will participate in incident response and coordinate with the Infrastructure team on platform dependencies and deployments.
* **Mentor and grow the team.** You’ll manage performance, career development, and hiring. You will hold the team accountable for delivery commitments while providing the mentorship needed to turn engineers into product-minded leaders.

## **We'd love to talk if you have**

* Real, demonstrable experience leading AI-first engineering. You champion the use of AI as a productivity multiplier for the team, and have led a team that ships with LLMs and AI tooling embedded in its daily workflow. You see AI as an enabler for higher velocity and output, not a replacement for engineering judgment, and hold strong, evidence-based views on what works and what doesn’t.
* Extensive experience leading technical teams in technical B2B SaaS or API-first products, with a track record of product-minded engineering teams that take initiative and ownership of product outcomes.
* A strong software engineering background with genuine full-stack fluency. You must have enough depth across the web stack to credibly lead and challenge senior web engineers. Hands-on experience with React and TypeScript is valuable, but sound engineering judgement and technical gravitas matter more than specific frameworks.
* You have a natural empathy and strong instincts for what developer customers want because you are the target user. You are genuinely excited about building developer tools and can tap into immediate feedback loops. You understand API design, documentation, and the nuances that differentiate a great developer journey.
* Experience at a startup or growth-stage company or adaptability to thrive in a fast-paced, agile environment with a focus on rapid iteration. To be effective in this role you’ll need excellent communication and cross-functional collaboration skills.

## **Bonus points if you have**

* Deep production experience building and shipping customer-facing web applications at scale with React and TypeScript.
* Experience delivering solutions used by software developers (developer tooling or APIs) or similar technical personas.
* An understanding of pub/sub and familiarity with distributed systems and event based architectures.

## **What’s it like to work at Ably?**

You'll join a team of around 60 people, working directly alongside senior engineering and leadership. No layers, no bureaucracy, and real ownership from day one.

### Remote-first

We hire the best people wherever they are across the UK and Europe, trust them to own their work, and share decisions and feedback openly. Twice a year, in February and August, we all meet in person, and we expect everyone to be there.

Remote-first comes with trade-offs. On one side: flexibility, no commute, long stretches of focus time, and a wider pool of people to hire from. On the other: it can feel isolating, relationships take effort to build, and you miss the chance conversations an office creates. As our only recruiter, you'll need to manage your own time and stay close to the hiring managers and candidates you work with.

If you do your best work with trust and autonomy, this will suit you. If you'd rather have an office around you every day, it probably isn't the right fit.

Our six values shape how we work day to day:

* **Open for all.** We default to sharing openly: source, decisions, and feedback, with open minds to match.
* **Tech needs humanity.** We build with empathy, for colleagues and developers alike.
* **Even the best do better.** We keep raising our own bar, driven by curiosity, not complacency.
* **Bias for action.** Once we know enough to act, we act, rather than waiting for certainty.
* **Dependable by default.** We take real ownership of what we ship and what we promise.
* **Bold creativity wins.** We treat big constraints as a reason to think differently, not less.

You can read more about how we defined these values on our blog, and see the team behind them on our careers page.

## Diversity, inclusion, and belonging at Ably

We believe our differences as individuals are what make us great. Our people are at the heart of what we do, and we encourage everyone to be their most authentic self at Ably: we see inclusivity and openness as fundamental to our long-term success. We encourage applications from all backgrounds regardless of age, disability, gender, sexual orientation, parental status, race, religion, educational background, or neurodiversity. Ably has an amazing opportunity ahead of us, and we want anyone to be able to contribute to it.

*If you enjoy working as part of a technology company, value open source, and love solving hard problems, we'd love to hear from you, regardless of whether you fit the job description exactly or not. If in doubt, drop us an email;; we're happy to give you advice on your application.*

## What you'll get

* A remote-first and flexible work environment. Our London office (next to Old Street) is there whenever you want it. Aside from our company get-togethers, you're welcome to work wherever suits you best.
* Equity. We're a growing start-up, and we want everyone to share in the company's success through our EMI share options programme.
* Enhanced holiday allowance: 28 days of paid annual leave (27 regular days, plus a day off to enjoy your birthday).
* Enhanced parental leave, so you can spend time with your new family member: up to 16 weeks fully paid for primary caregivers and 4 weeks for secondary, depending on length of service.
* A home workstation budget of £500 on joining (and £150 per year after that), so your home office serves you well.
* A personal learning and development budget of £1000 a year, plus 5% L&D time during working hours to build your skills.
* Private healthcare with BUPA.
* A medical cash plan covering a range of medical and dental costs.
* Mental wellbeing coaching and counselling from Self Space.
* A monthly wellbeing budget via Juno.
* Life assurance and income protection.
* Access to Tech and Cycle to Work schemes.
* A weekly snack allowance for our end-of-week "Need to Know" meeting.
* A fully-paid one-month sabbatical after five years with Ably.

The Delivery team is responsible for the full construction lifecycle, following handoff from the development team who is responsible for pre-construction planning and permitting. The delivery function manages scope, schedule, budget, and risk mitigation throughout construction, commissioning, and turnover to operations with the goal of delivering scalable future ready solutions that meet the evolving needs of our customers in line with commercial performance targets. The delivery team executes on the vision and global products generated by the Product and Innovation teams while providing cost and schedule inputs for their future outputs.
Summary:
The Delivery Lead for EMEA is accountable for the end‑to‑end construction and delivery of Ada Infrastructure’s development portfolio, overseeing all active and future EMEA campuses. In this role you will have the opportunity to provide strategic leadership, governance, and operational oversight across multiple large‑scale, capital‑intensive data center developments, ensuring projects are delivered safely, on time, within budget, and aligned with Ada’s commercial, technical, and operational objectives.

This role spans all of EMEA Delivery, including campus‑based delivery teams (e.g. Docklands and other UK and European locations). You will also serve as Ada’s senior construction delivery authority in the region. The position will partner closely with Development, Design, Product, Finance, Sales, Operations, EHS, ESG, and executive leadership, while representing Delivery in customer, vendor, and Board‑level discussions.
Responsibilities
Own and execute the EMEA delivery strategy across all EMEA campuses, from pre-construction handoff through commissioning and turnover to operations including but not limited to leading the tender/contractor selection, contracting, construction and power delivery, coordinating LLE purchase and delivery, and project closeout
Lead, manage, and develop a high performing regional delivery team, of ADA and contract employees
Establish and continuously refine delivery governance, processes, controls, and reporting standards to enable scalable execution across multiple markets.
Ensure consistent application of Ada’s global design standards, delivery methodologies, and risk management frameworks across all campuses
Maintain full accountability for regional CAPEX performance, including budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and cost controls
Provide clear, executive level reporting on portfolio status, risks, opportunities, and performance metrics including project level cost analysis, budget/estimating insight, and cost driver transparency
Oversee regional contractor and vendor strategies, including MSAs, GPAs, SOWs, and contractor qualification
Drive execution excellence with Design team across CSA and MEP intensive construction programs, ensuring constructability, schedule integrity, and quality outcomes
Identify and mitigate program level risks, including schedule, supply chain, labour, permitting, and power delivery constraints
Collaborate with the Development, Design and Project Controls teams to identify cost optimization opportunities and Incorporate prefabrication, modularization, and alternate delivery strategies to improve speed, cost certainty, and scalability
Champion a proactive safety culture across all sites, embedding safety as a baseline expectation, leading by example, and ensuring safety is treated as a core value rather than a compliance driven exercise
Partner with EHS and ESG leadership to ensure delivery outcomes align with Ada’s sustainability and environmental commitments
Act as the senior Delivery interface for EMEA with customers, hyperscalers, and strategic partners and support Sales in leasing pursuits through customer engagement, construction related RFP responses, and delivery commitments
Ensure consistent and accurate use of delivery systems (e.g., Procore, Primavera P6) as sources of truth across the region

Bachelor’s degree in construction management, Engineering, or related discipline; equivalent experience considered
15+ years of experience delivering large-scale, capital-intensive construction programs, with 10+ years in senior leadership roles
Extensive experience delivering mission critical or data center infrastructure required
Proven leadership of multi-site, multi-billion dollar construction portfolios
Deep expertise in CSA and MEP construction, construction means and methods, and delivery models
Strong commercial and financial acumen, including CAPEX management, contract strategy, and risk allocation
Executive presence with the ability to influence internally and externally at the LT and customer level

# Assurance & Deal Desk Analyst (EDI)

Edinburgh, UK

**Who We Are**

Addepar is a global data and AI platform empowering investment professionals to turn complex financial information into actionable intelligence. Addepar unifies portfolio, market and client data in a total portfolio view and delivers AI-powered insights within investment and client workflows. More than 1,500 firms in 60 countries use Addepar to manage and advise on nearly $10 trillion in assets. Its open platform integrates with 650 software, data and consulting partners to power end-to-end investment operations across firms of all sizes and levels of complexity. Addepar supports clients worldwide with offices in New York City, Salt Lake City, São Paulo, London, Edinburgh, Geneva, Warsaw, Dubai, Pune and Singapore.

#### **The Role**

We are currently seeking an Assurance & Deal Desk Analyst to join our GTM Operations team in Edinburgh. As an Assurance & Deal Desk Analyst, you will be the operational backbone of two connected processes: client and prospect Assurance (security and compliance due diligence, including trust center profiles and bespoke questionnaires) and Deal Desk (quoting, approvals and contracting). You will keep deals moving, hold the line on process and policy, and work closely with cross-functional leaders across Information Security & Risk (ISR), Legal, Compliance, Product, Finance and Sales to make both processes faster and more scalable.

Applicants must have, and maintain, the right to work in the United Kingdom from the first day of employment. Please note that visa sponsorship is not available for this role.

**What You’ll Do**

* Own the day-to-day operations of the client and prospect Assurance process: triage incoming due-diligence requests, confirm prerequisites (such as an NDA on file for prospects), and guide GTM partners on sharing the right trust center (Whistic) profile based on client ARR tier.
* Manage the Assurance Jira intake queue: review bespoke documentation and questionnaire requests, apply ARR-tier rules, route exceptions for approval, and track every request to completion against clear turnaround targets.
* Coordinate responses to bespoke security and compliance questionnaires using approved collateral, partnering with subject-matter experts in ISR, Legal, Compliance and Product to keep answers accurate and consistent.
* Support the Deal Desk process in Salesforce and CPQ: quote review, SOW and order form routing, and approval workflows across GTM Operations, Finance and Legal; review deals for policy and pricing compliance and escalate non-standard terms.
* Build trusted working relationships with cross-functional leaders in ISR, Legal, Compliance, Product, Finance and Sales; set clear expectations on timing and resolve competing priorities to keep deals moving.
* Maintain our trust center profiles and approved answer library, flagging stale or missing content and driving updates with content owners.
* Keep Salesforce and Jira records (contacts, accounts, NDA status, profile share and access data, request status) accurate and audit-ready.
* Report on Assurance and Deal Desk volume, turnaround time and bottlenecks, and take initiative to design, document and continuously improve repeatable processes, leading small-to-medium process improvement and automation projects with limited guidance.
* Contribute to GTM Operations process documentation and enablement for Sales and Client Success teams.

#### **Who You Are**

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience.
* At least four years of related experience in sales operations, deal desk, security or compliance operations, contracts, or a similar process-driven role (or at least two years of related experience with a Master’s degree).
* Highly organized, operationally focused and strongly process-oriented: you naturally think in workflows, SLAs and repeatable steps, and have a track record of managing many concurrent requests, deadlines and handoffs without letting anything slip.
* Hands-on experience with Jira and Salesforce (or another CRM) to manage queues, workflows and records.
* Able to work effectively with cross-functional leaders in ISR, Legal, Compliance, Product and other teams, translating between business, security and legal needs and building consensus without direct authority.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills, comfortable explaining policy and process to sales and client stakeholders.
* Sound judgment on when to apply the rules and when to escalate; able to work with little supervision.
* Proficient in Excel or Google Sheets.
* Self-motivated and proactive: you take ownership without waiting to be asked, drive work to completion independently, and know when to bring others in.
* A plus: familiarity with trust centers and security questionnaire platforms (Whistic, Vanta, SafeBase or similar).
* A plus: experience with CPQ, SOC 2 / ISO 27001, common due-diligence questionnaires (SIG, CAIQ, DDQ), or a background in financial services, wealth management or enterprise SaaS

**Our Values**

* **Act Like an Owner -** Think and operate with intention, purpose and care. Own outcomes.
* **Build Together -** Collaborate to unlock the best solutions. Deliver lasting value.
* **Champion Our Clients -** Exceed client expectations. Our clients’ success is our success.
* **Drive Innovation -** Be bold and unconstrained in problem solving. Transform the industry.
* **Embrace Learning -** Engage our community to broaden our perspective. Bring a growth mindset.

In addition to our core values, Addepar is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We seek to bring together diverse ideas, experiences, skill sets, perspectives, backgrounds and identities to drive innovative solutions. We commit to promoting a welcoming environment where inclusion and belonging are held as a shared responsibility.

We will ensure that individuals with disabilities are provided reasonable accommodation to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and to receive other benefits and privileges of employment. Please contact us to request accommodation.

PHISHING SCAM WARNING: Addepar is among several companies recently made aware of a phishing scam involving con artists posing as hiring managers recruiting via email, text and social media. The imposters are creating misleading email accounts, conducting remote “interviews,” and making fake job offers in order to collect personal and financial information from unsuspecting individuals. Please be aware that no job offers will be made from Addepar without a formal interview process. Additionally, Addepar will not ask you to purchase equipment or supplies as part of your onboarding process. If you have any questions, please reach out to ta-operations@addepar.com.

**About the team**

Regulatory & Compliance is where we build the trust, discipline, and operational resilience required to scale a generational financial platform.

As Airwallex grows across 30+ markets, this team turns regulatory complexity into strategic control. You'll lead compliance, enterprise risk, and regulatory engagement in a way that protects the business while letting it move with conviction. Our ambition goes beyond meeting expectations: we're building a risk posture that acts as a competitive moat, grounded in ownership, proactive regulatory partnerships, and frameworks that scale globally while respecting local nuance.

It's a team for strategic operators with sharp judgment, high standards, and the confidence to execute at pace in a high-stakes environment. You'll thrive here if you can balance rigor with progress and influence across functions.

If you want to architect the benchmark for trust and resilience in global finance, your work here will have a massive impact.

**What you'll do**

As the Senior Manager, Financial Crime Investigations & Intelligence, you’ll lead proactive, complex, and high-risk anti-money laundering and financial crime investigations across Airwallex’s global financial infrastructure. You’ll act as an investigative subject-matter expert and operational lead, helping identify and mitigate risks across cross-border payments, corporate accounts, cards, FX and embedded finance.

**Responsibilities:**

* Lead end-to-end investigations into complex financial crime typologies involving cross-border payment flows, multi-currency corporate accounts, complex ownership structures, cross-product financial-crime risks, KYB/UBO considerations and high-risk corridors.
* Oversee case intake, triage, prioritisation and assignment for special investigations, ensuring matters requiring enhanced investigative expertise are resolved thoroughly and within established SLAs.
* Lead financial-crime-related internal fraud and insider-threat investigations where employees or insiders may be involved in fraud, collusion with external parties, misuse of access or other conduct with a financial-crime nexus. Partner with Fraud, Infosec, People/HR, Employment Legal and senior management. Provide evidence-based findings and risk-based recommendations.
* Analyse layered international transactions across payment rails including SWIFT, local clearing rails, card schemes and alternative payment methods to trace illicit fund movements, identify beneficial owners and uncover hidden counterparty networks.
* Provide investigative analysis, suspect and typology recommendations, quality assurance and escalation support for SAR/STR cases, enabling MLROs to make final filing decisions in accordance with local requirements.
* Translate investigative findings into actionable feedback for Risk, Data and Engineering teams to calibrate transaction monitoring rules, improve automated detection models and address control vulnerabilities.
* Develop and maintain financial-crime typologies, investigative intelligence and threat assessment based on internal investigations, external intelligence, and regulatory guidance; translate these insights into control improvements, targeted training and intelligence briefings.
* Partner with Transaction Monitoring, Onboarding and EDD, Sanctions, Fraud, Legal and regional MLROs to address systemic threats and implement coordinated risk-mitigation measures.
* Build and maintain investigative playbooks, investigative analysis, typology context and case documentation standards and quality-assurance frameworks tailored to B2B fintech, complex law-enforcement referrals, regulatory information request, partner-bank inquiries and partner due-diligence reviews..
* Support internal audits, independent reviews and regulatory inquiries with clear documentation, case files and briefings on investigative methodologies and outcomes.
* Provide day-to-day guidance, peer reviews and typology training to investigators and analysts across the broader Financial Crime Compliance team.

**Who you are**

We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.

**Minimum qualifications:**

* 8+ years of dedicated experience in AML/CFT investigations, financial intelligence or special investigations within cross-border payments, global fintech, merchant acquiring or international corporate and commercial banking.
* Deep understanding of cross-border payment mechanisms, including SWIFT, local ACH and clearing schemes, and FX; business payment flows; merchant acquiring; and corporate entity structures, including complex shareholding, shell companies and beneficial ownership.
* A proven track record of independently conducting and documenting complex, multi-layered financial crime investigations from initiation through documented findings, risk recommendations and support to the MLRO-led regulatory reporting process.
* Solid working knowledge of global AML/CTF and sanctions regulatory frameworks, including, where applicable,FATF recommendations, FinCEN/BSA, FCA, AUSTRAC,MAS and other relevant local regulatory requirements.
* A strong analytical mindset, with experience querying, synthesising and interpreting large datasets of transactional and customer data.
* Exceptional written communication skills, demonstrated through investigative narratives and SAR/STR drafting, with the ability to articulate complex financial crime risks to non-compliance stakeholders, including Product and Engineering.
* Comfort working in a high-growth and rapidly evolving fintech environment, managing competing priorities under tight deadlines.

**Preferred qualifications:**

* A professional certification such as CAMS, CFE or an equivalent ICA diploma.
* Practical experience with data querying and visualisation tools such as SQL, Python, Tableau or network/link analysis software.
* Experience investigating financial crime risks in digital assets or crypto rails, or embedded finance/BaaS integrations.

You will support quality throughout the manufacturing process, from reviewing inspection results and investigating non-conformances through to implementing corrective actions and improving processes.

Alongside the day-to-day production focus, you will also help ensure our manufacturing processes continue to meet the requirements of ISO 9001.

This would suit someone who enjoys being close to manufacturing and solving real production problems, rather than working primarily on Quality Management System administration.

---

* Be a regular quality presence on the shop floor, supporting technicians and production teams with day-to-day quality issues.

* Help make sure manufacturing activities are carried out in accordance with drawings, specifications and controlled processes.

* Use quality and process data to identify opportunities for continuous improvement.
* Support the introduction of new or revised manufacturing processes from a quality perspective.
* Help improve work instructions, inspection methods and quality procedures based on what is happening in production.
* Support internal audits and the ongoing requirements of our ISO 9001 Quality Management System.
* Work closely with engineering, production and quality colleagues to make sure customer requirements are understood and achieved.

---

* Experience working in quality within a manufacturing or precision engineering environment.
* Comfortable working directly with production teams in a hands-on shop-floor environment.
* Experience investigating manufacturing defects or non-conformances.
* Experience applying structured problem-solving and root-cause analysis techniques within a manufacturing environment.

* Internal auditing experience.
* Willingness to work flexible hours or morning/afternoon shifts where required.

About AlphaSense: 
AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.
About the Team:
The Content organization is responsible for identifying, creating or licensing and integrating best-in-class unstructured and structured content into the AlphaSense platform. The team reports to the Chief Content Officer and has strategy, product and content management, collection operations and support responsibilities for each Content vertical. We have been experiencing rapid growth across all content sets. We value and uphold transparency, trust, and accountability in our relationships within the Content teams and with external partners and internal stakeholders.
About the Role: 
We are seeking a Product Manager for New Content Evaluation and Analysis to help us expand and strengthen the breadth, quality, and value of the data and content that power our Platform. Candidates should have deep knowledge of capital markets and investment research combined with extensive experience of evaluating and integrating financial research content and AI-powered investment analysis workflows.
Major Areas of Responsibilities:
Identify the Need and Showcase the Value: Help identify and evaluate third-party quantitative and qualitative datasets and content for the needs of the AlphaSense platform (e.g. market data, fundamentals, estimates, ESG, news, research, transcripts, regulatory filings, and alternative data). Work alongside Partnership Management and Content Leads to assess data quality, methodology, licensing terms, and integration feasibility.
Lead the Due Diligence Effort: Run point individually or leading a due-diligence analyst team on active vendor evaluations, including data trials, support proofs of concept, and own the framework to evaluate coverage, timeliness, accuracy, and history analysis. Help build content org-wide business case for new datasets and quantify value proposition, cost, buy vs build impact, and strategic fit.
Become a Use Case Expert for AlphaSense content. Contribute to market research and competitive analysis to identify net new opportunities for innovation and differentiation. Identify new high impact AI-driven functionality and data sets and formulate the licensing target vendor or self-sourcing strategy to introduce new content into the AlphaSense platform and agentic workflows.
Market Research and Assessment: Track industry trends and competing platforms, solutions, and content to deliver competitive intelligence and better evolve product and content vision. Keep abreast of a rapidly evolving competitive landscape and client expectations along with unprecedented LLM and AI workflow advances. 
Who You Are:
You have genuine excitement and passion for corporate finance, capital markets, and investment research coupled with data management expertise demonstrated either in previous capacity at a buy-side or sell-side firm or you have successfully supported AI products/features/data used by investment and data analysis professionals
You have natural enthusiasm for working at the intersection of AI, data, technology, and investment research and track record of expert-level data analysis at scale using traditional data query or generative AI tools and platforms
You have the energy and enthusiasm to work in a high-paced, high-growth environment and you are comfortable accommodating rapidly changing business priorities
You have excellent presentation skills with demonstrated ability to inform and influence executives and align with multiple levels of stakeholders
You have driven successful due diligence project outcomes or run content evaluations with diverse businesses and teams across multiple locations 
You demonstrate empathic communication, with the ability to listen and identify problems in need of solutions
REQUIRED
At least 5 years of work experience at a leading financial institution or investment research platform firm focused on the delivery or evaluation of content, features, analytics, and models for front-office investment professionals
Proficient knowledge of contemporary market data and investment research databases, products, and workflow tools (e.g.: Fundamentals, Estimates, Transactions data, Ownership data, Market data, News, Transcripts)
Strong understanding of the logical structure of relational and JSON databases. Demonstrated experience of running complex data queries and analyses using traditional data- query or contemporary generative AI techniques is required. Close familiarity and hands-on experience with Claude Code or similar platforms is a must
Demonstrated ability to collaborate with a dedicated cross-functional product development or evaluation teams of engineers, content leads, and vendor management professionals
A track record of successful collaboration and delivery with a globally distributed team is a must. Prior formal or informal team leadership experience is strongly preferred.
Demonstrated ability to set priorities, stay focused, and meet or beat deadlines
BSc degree or material academic background in a quantitative analysis field 
PREFERRED
Experience in content acquisition and licensing
Prior experience at a market intelligence or financial research SaaS start-up
Exposure to iterative / agile development methodologies in the context of product development
Experience working with and leading distributed teams

## **About Anthropic**

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

## **About the role**

The Anthropic Residency is our paid, fixed-term research program, with placements lasting between six weeks and six months. We are looking for people who have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields and want to transition to full-time work focused on making sure AI systems are safe and beneficial for all of humanity. If you are a **professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer** and want to transition to work on transformative AI, we want to hear from you. Background in machine learning is not required.

## **What to expect**

* A concrete, scoped project matched to your background, with direct mentorship from Anthropic researchers
* Access to Claude models and GPU compute
* Connection to the broader AI safety and security research community

## **Interview process**

The interview process will include an initial application, recruiter screen, technical assessment, research discussion and a reference check.

Applications for this round close on November 22, 2026 (11:59 PM PT). We expect to make offers in January 2027.

## **You may be a good fit if you**

* Are motivated by making sure AI is safe and beneficial for society as a whole
* Are excited to transition into working on empirical AI research full-time
* Have led ambitious work in a variety of technical fields (professor in a quantitative discipline, a technical founder or a staff-level engineer)
* Thrive in fast-paced, collaborative environments
* Can implement ideas quickly and communicate clearly

## **Strong candidates may also**

* Have experience authoring research papers in machine learning, NLP, or AI safety
* Have experience with LLMs, reinforcement learning or Kubernetes clusters and complex shared codebases

## **Mentors and research areas**

Potential Anthropic mentors include:

* Sara Price: leads the Alignment Training team; background in data science
* Ethan Perez: leads the Alignment Science team; background in machine learning
* Evan Hubinger: leads the Alignment Stress-Testing team; formerly at The Machine Intelligence Research Institute (MIRI)
* Samuel Marks: leads the Scalable Oversight team; background in mathematics
* Elana Simon: researches the interpretability of language models and biological models; background in biomedical informatics
* Belinda Li: researches how language models represent the world, users, and themselves; background in natural language processing (PhD, MIT)
* Jack Lindsey: leads the Model Psychology team; background in theoretical neuroscience
* Nicholas Carlini: researches adversarial machine learning and AI security; previously at DeepMind and Google Brain
* Jascha Sohl-Dickstein: works at the intersection of safety and pretraining; background in physics and neuroscience, formerly Principal Scientist at Google Brain

Residents will work on empirical research questions in collaboration with Anthropic's research teams. Areas we are particularly interested in include:

AI safety & alignment

* Scalable Oversight: Developing techniques to keep highly capable models helpful and honest, even as they surpass human-level intelligence in various domains.
* Adversarial Robustness and AI Control: Creating methods to ensure advanced AI systems remain safe and harmless in unfamiliar or adversarial scenarios.
* Model Organisms: Creating model organisms of misalignment to improve our empirical understanding of how alignment failures might arise.
* Model Internals and Interpretability: Advancing our understanding of the internal workings of large language models to enable more targeted interventions and safety measures.
* Safeguards Research: Developing robust defenses against adversarial attacks, comprehensive evaluation frameworks for model safety, and automated systems to detect and mitigate potential risks before deployment.
* AI Welfare: Improving our understanding of potential AI welfare and developing related evaluations and mitigations.

AI security & frontier red-teaming

* Stress-testing frontier models to understand the full extent of their current capabilities in fields such as cybersecurity, robotics or cryptography.

ML systems & reinforcement learning

* Improving how frontier models are trained and building the infrastructure behind that research, from model architecture, optimizers and training data to accelerator simulators, hardware backends and RL environment pipelines.

For a fuller picture of the questions we care about, see our Recommendations for Technical AI Safety Research Directions and recent publications from our Alignment, Interpretability and Frontier Red teams.

* **Duration:** Placements are six weeks, three months or six months, depending on team fit and candidate preferences. Other lengths between three and six months are possible by exception.

# Aon Graduate Programme 2027 - Commercial Risk Consulting

**Commercial Risk Consulting - Graduate Programme 2027**

**Start Date** 1st September 2027

**Application closing date** 7th December 2026 *Please note, we may close earlier if we receive the quantity, quality & diversity of applications required.*

**Better Decisions Begin with You**

At Aon, we shape decisions for the better to protect and enrich the lives of people around the world. As an organisation, we are united through trust as one inclusive, diverse team, and we are passionate about helping our colleagues and clients succeed.

**Launch Your Career in Commercial Risk Consulting**

Join Aon as a Commercial Risk Consulting graduate and, from day one, you’ll be an integral part of either our Strategic Engagement (Inpoint) or Aon M&A and Transaction Solutions (AMATS) team. You’ll help clients navigate complex business challenges, handle risk and make better-informed decisions.

**Strategic Engagement (Inpoint):**

Inpoint is Aon’s carrier engagement and management business, working primarily with insurers across Commercial Risk. Our teams use market insight, portfolio analytics and Aon’s broader capabilities to build stronger, more strategic relationships with carrier partners.

Strategic Engagement is focused on helping Aon and its carrier partners identify shared priorities, understand portfolio performance and turn insight into meaningful action. This is not a traditional strategy consulting role. It is a relationship-led, data-informed opportunity at the centre of Aon’s engagement with the insurance market.

As a Strategic Engagement Graduate, you will work with colleagues across Strategy & Technology Group (STG), the Global Broking Centre (GBC) and Commercial Risk UK. You will help prepare insight for senior conversations with insurers, support engagement on portfolio opportunities and contribute to initiatives that strengthen how Aon and its carrier partners work together.

The role offers exposure to senior leaders across Aon and the insurance market. It also provides the chance to build a strong understanding of commercial insurance, carrier priorities, broking, and portfolio dynamics.

**What You Will Do**

* **Analyse market, carrier and portfolio information** to identify trends and opportunities, turning data and analytics into practical insights for carrier and internal partners discussions
* **Support strategic relationship planning and engagement** for key insurers, helping teams establish clear priorities, actions and follow-through while deepening your knowledge of customer relationship management
* **Collaborate across Inpoint, GBC and Commercial Risk UK** to understand carrier objectives, capture insight and coordinate engagement with the market, building your project management and consulting skills over time
* **Contribute to strategic carrier meetings and senior collaborator discussions** and learn how strong commercial relationships are developed throughout Aon and the insurance sector
* **Prepare clear, high-quality materials and presentations** for strategic meetings and portfolio reviews, using focused research and document review to communicate complex information concisely

**Aon M&A and Transaction Solutions (AMATS):**

Mergers and Acquisitions (M&A) and other event-driven situations can be complex, time-critical and highly specialised. The AMATS team typically assists clients in three core areas, prior to, during and/or after completion of an M&A deal or other investment opportunity, by:

* Providing due diligence on an ‘target’ business across a wide range of deal-critical areas, including risk & insurance, cyber & digital, human capital and climate maters. This diligence evaluates the target’s risk exposures - past, current, and future - which may impact transaction value for the buyer
* Arranging insurance solutions aimed at de-risking transaction liabilities and enhancing investor returns, often removing deal-breaking risks. This involves structuring and placing solutions like warranty & indemnity insurance and using insurance capital to mitigate contingent risks, such as tax and litigation
* Delivering portfolio value creation programmes for financial sponsors, including private equity, infrastructure funds, and real estate investors. Use their portfolio scale and insights from analysis. Coordinate efforts to reduce the total cost of risk and improve governance

The clients include financial sponsors  and Corporates, with transaction sizes ranging from small UK domestic deals (such as Voyage Care’s acquisition of Orchard Healthcare) to some of the largest cross-border transactions (such as KONE’s $34.4 billion combination with TK Elevators). Further deal examples can be found on Aon’s LinkedIn page.

You’ll gain exposure to several parts of our transaction advisory and broking business to help build your understanding of why clients implement M&A deals and how Aon supports their business and investment objectives.

**What You Will Do**

* **Support transaction advisory work** for private equity, infrastructure, real estate and corporate clients, helping the team research and analyse risks connected with M&A deals
* **Support the arrangement of M&A insurance solutions** by helping colleagues prepare information for the insurance market and learning how transaction risks can be transferred
* **Coordinate Aon expertise across practices and geographies** while developing your internal network and learning to handle actions and workstreams across a fast-moving transaction process
* **Help identify relevant Aon products, services and solutions** that may support client deal and investment objectives, applying commercial judgement and broader business context
* **Build strong collaborative connections** with clients, insurers, M&A advisers and internal collaborators, while developing your consulting and business communication skills over time

**Your Development**

As an Aon Graduate, you will be enrolled onto our Launch Programme when you join. Alongside your broader development, you will progressively build the technical and professional capabilities needed for the role. This development programme is built around the following core elements: As your experience grows, you will also learn to apply client, industry and risk context when reviewing AI-generated insights, and to coordinate digital tools, specialist resources and stakeholders as part of an effective delivery workflow.

*1. Business learning*. On the job learning and experiences giving you the opportunity to develop your knowledge and understanding of the team and solution line you have joined.

*2. Centralised learning*. Our UK graduates complete in an Aon Induction, monthly webinars, business skills training and workshops; all designed to help you develop your knowledge of Aon, build your confidence and your network across our business.

*3. Professional Qualifications.* To enable you to be as successful as possible, as part of your role, you will be expected to complete our Go Further Apprenticeship programmes. We’ll fully support your study towards the level 4 Diploma in Insurance from the CII (Chartered Insurance Institute) and beyond. To support you as you study for your exams, you’ll receive paid study leave, plus an extensive range of study and tuition materials.

**Your career beyond your Graduate programme**

Once you’ve completed the formal graduate programme, you’ll continue to receive lots of support at Aon. As well as continued technical and business skills training, you’ll receive support for your CII qualifications. To aid your professional development you’ll receive regular performance feedback, and work with your line manager towards promotions.

**Next Steps**

If you are interested in this programme and would like to apply, here is some useful information:

Please review the information on each team and select your first-choice preferred team should you be successful. Please note that, where possible, we will try to consider you for your first-choice preference, however we cannot guarantee your first choice due to availability of roles. If your top preference is unavailable at the time of your Assessment Centre, we will also consider you for the other teams.

**Entry Requirements:**

* You will need to have or be on track to achieve a 2:1 degree (or equivalent) in any degree subject.
* To ensure compliance with UK law, successful candidates must demonstrate their right to work in the UK throughout the duration of their time in role.

**What are we looking for?**

* **Motivation and ambition to pursue a career in Commercial Risk Consulting.** You should be able to explain why Strategic Engagement (Inpoint) or AMATS at Aon interests you and how it aligns with your longer-term goals
* **AI literacy, prompt engineering and AI judgement.** Comfortable using AI-enabled technologies such as Copilot, analytics platforms and digital productivity tools, able to refine outputs and assess their accuracy, relevance and appropriateness
* **Client centricity, strategic thinking and commercial awareness.** Curious about the insurance market and able to connect your work to client and carrier outcomes while considering wider business priorities
* **Critical thinking, problem solving and analytical skills.** Able to analyse information, identify patterns, challenge assumptions and draw evidence-based conclusions using digital tools and data
* **Strong communication and collaboration skills.** Able to explain complex information clearly, ask thoughtful questions and build positive working relationships with a range of internal and external partners
* **Results driven, dependable and adaptable.** Takes ownership, applies feedback, continuously develops skills and can manage changing priorities while delivering accurate, high-quality work
* **Inclusive.** Values different perspectives, challenges assumptions and helps create an environment where everyone feels respected and able to contribute

**Locations:**

Here are the locations where we have graduate opportunities this year: **London**

We recognise the value for our Early Career colleagues of being in the office environment from the beginning of their programme. As a new graduate, you will spend the first 6 months based in the office to support your learning, development, and progression. This will enable you access to support from managers, collaborate with colleagues as well as grow your network across Aon. After completing this initial training period, you will then have the opportunity to work more flexibly, spending at least 3 to 4 days face to face in the Aon office or with clients.

**Aon UK Graduate Recruitment: What to Expect**

We know applying for your first graduate role can be exciting, and sometimes a little daunting. At Aon, we’re committed to making our recruitment process as transparent and supportive as possible. Here’s how our selection journey works, and what you can expect at each stage:

**1. Application Review**

* We process applications on a rolling basis, moving candidates forward as they complete each stage.
* Every application is carefully reviewed by our team (not by AI).
* Due to the high volume of interest, this stage can take up to two weeks.
* Please note: We do not review CVs or cover letters at this point.

**2. Online Assessment**

* We understand you want to put your best foot forward, so you’ll have 5 calendar days to complete the online assessment.
* If you need more time, just let us know as extensions are available.

**3. Video Interview**

* Preparation matters, so you’ll have up to 10 days (240 hours) from receiving your invitation to record and submit your video interview.
* Rest assured: Every video interview is reviewed by a real member of our recruitment team, not an AI system.
* You’ll typically hear back from us within 2-3 weeks after submitting your interview, though times may vary depending on the number of applications.

**4. Assessment Centres**

* Our assessment centres are held in person at the Aon office closest to the location you applied for.
* Please note: Due to the large number of applications, not every candidate who completes a video interview will be invited to an assessment centre.
* Assessment centres usually run after Christmas, from mid-January.
* If selected, you’ll have 7-14 days’ notice to help you arrange any travel.
* We run a limited number of Assessment Centre so please make every effort to attend if invited.
* We reimburse reasonable travel costs (such as standard class train tickets). Flights and hotels are only covered if agreed in advance.
* At the assessment centre stage, your CV and cover letter will be shared with hiring managers. This helps them get a fuller picture of you as a candidate—but these documents are not used for initial screening.

**What is Aon's guidance of the use of AI during the selection process?**

As an innovative global leader, we recognize and embrace the power of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help job seekers be more efficient in their recruitment processes. In fact, Aon is in the business of developing and implementing innovative AI tools that support both colleagues and clients, which you’ll use as an Aon colleague if you join our team.

AI can be a helpful tool for researching Aon, preparing for interviews or refining your CV, it should support, not replace, your own thinking, judgement, skills and experiences. Any application materials you submit should accurately reflect your achievements, capabilities and potential.

We ask that you refrain from using AI when completing assessments or during live or pre-recorded interview processes, which will often include an in-person interview where the technology will not be available to you. Additionally, virtual or in-person interviews should not be recorded or transcribed.

At Aon, we foster a culture of inclusiveness, fairness and transparency. We expect all candidates to embrace these principles in every interaction with us.

**Can I apply for more than one programme or role?**

We ask candidates to submit one Early Carers application per recruitment cycle. We encourage you to explore our opportunities carefully and apply for the programme or role that best matches your skills, interests and career goals. This helps you focus on submitting your strongest application and ensures we can assess candidates fairly and efficiently.

If, during the selection process, we believe another opportunity at Aon may be a better fit for your experience and aspirations, our recruitment team may discuss alternative options with you.

If you're unsure which programme is right for you, we recommend reviewing the programme information on our careers site or attending one of our events before applying.**Top Tip**: Choose the role you're most excited about, rather than treating a second application as a back-up option. We want to understand where your genuine interests lie and how you see your future career developing.**We’re here to support you every step of the way. If you have any questions or need accommodations, just contact our team -****graduates@aon.co.uk****. Good luck, and we look forward to seeing what you can bring to Aon!**

# Senior Software Engineer

* **Salary:** £85,000 - £100,000
* **Location / working pattern:** Hybrid, London, 2 days a week in the office
* **Background checks:** Due to the non-partisan nature of the work we do with global governments and partners, all employees need to pass background checks, verifying your identity, education (if relevant), work history, sanctions, criminal record, adverse financial history, and right to work. To ensure we maintain high standards of political neutrality, we also perform media and social media checks.

#### About Apolitical

Apolitical's mission is to make governments smarter to deliver for people and the planet and we reach over 40 million public servants through our partnerships with governments globally. We are the largest global network for governments, used by 500,000+ public servants in 170 countries to find and share best practices and gain skills on critical topics from AI to climate change to emerging technologies.

Governments use Apolitical to solve public sector transformation challenges from AI augmentation to reskilling. We offer governments five interoperable components: research and analysis, workforce productivity tools, customisable training, vibrant learning communities and high impact convenings. Everything we do is powered by our unique global network and real-time data.

#### The Role

Apolitical is becoming a multi-module, AI-enabled platform for governments. Our priority is to build products that help public servants understand, adopt and make effective use of AI and emerging technologies.

Every one of our products is AI native, built with TypeScript, React and NextJS on the front end and NestJS for back-end services, hosted across multiple cloud platforms. Our engineers work across the stack and close to the problems our users face.

As a Senior Software Engineer, you will take ownership of complex features and systems across the front end and back end, from shaping the problem with Product to shipping and checking the impact. Your immediate mandate is to deliver product work for our government partners while making architecture decisions that keep our platform maintainable as it grows.

This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role, with no direct reports, in a team of engineers who share technical direction. You will work closely with Product, Design and fellow engineers, and with government partners where a feature needs it.

**You will:**

* **Build product features end to end** – design, build and release features across the front end and back end, from the first problem statement to production.
* **Shape what we build** – work with Product, Design and government partners to turn user needs into well-scoped work, challenging assumptions when the evidence points elsewhere.
* **Design systems and architecture** – lead the technical design of complex features and contribute to decisions on our architecture, platform and technology stack.
* **Build AI into our products** – integrate AI capabilities into our products, with the evaluation and safeguards that public sector users need.
* **Keep our software reliable** – test, monitor and maintain what you build in production, and review code and technical designs from other engineers.
* **Raise engineering standards** – mentor other engineers and improve how the team builds software, including how we use AI tools in development.

#### Onboarding Milestones

**Within your first month, you'll:**

* Understand our products, users and codebase, and ship your first changes to production.
* Learn how Product, Design and Engineering plan and prioritise work.
* Take ownership of a first feature, agreeing its scope with Product.

**Within three months, you'll:**

* Be delivering features end to end with little direction.
* Be contributing to technical design decisions and reviewing code across the team.
* Have shaped at least one piece of work from a broad problem statement with Product and Design.

**Within six months, you'll:**

* Have led the technical design of a complex feature or system through to production.
* Be a go-to reviewer and mentor for other engineers.
* Be improving how the team builds, for example in testing, observability or our use of AI tools.

#### About you

You will have experience building and maintaining production software across the front end and back end with TypeScript, React and Node.js, in teams where engineers own features and work closely with Product.

**You'll thrive here if you:**

* Ship to learn, releasing small changes early and using what users do to decide what comes next.
* Take responsibility rather than wait for permission, making sound decisions with incomplete information.
* Finish what you start, then help others finish theirs.
* Only merge code you can explain, whether you or an AI tool wrote it.
* Balance delivering results now with the longer-term impact of your technical decisions.
* Raise the bar for the engineers around you through code review, pairing and constructive challenge.
* Are motivated by building technology that helps governments work better for people and the planet.

**Show us in your CV if you have:**

* Experience with NextJS or NestJS in production.
* Experience building product features that use large language models or other AI services.
* Experience with testing practices such as TDD, acceptance test-driven development or testing in production.
