**About us**

  

Linklaters is a leading international law firm, with over 30 offices across 20 countries. We advise many of the world's leading corporates, financial institutions and governments on their most important and complex matters.

  

Ours is an environment of outperformance. We achieve this not through targets and incentives, but by fostering a collaborative, supportive and inclusive culture where talented people can do their best work. We combine legal excellence with innovation, embracing new technologies and ways of working that help us deliver exceptional outcomes for our clients.

  

As AI becomes increasingly central to the future of legal services, Linklaters is investing significantly in technology, data and applied intelligence. This role offers a unique opportunity to join us at the forefront of that transformation and play an important part in turning an ambitious AI strategy into action across a complex global organisation.

**The role**

AI sits at the heart of Linklaters' strategy. We are seeking an exceptional Chief of Staff (AI & Applied Intelligence) to work closely with the Director of AI Delivery and the partner leading the firm's AI strategy, helping to drive forward one of the firm's most strategically important programmes.

  

This is first and foremost a strategy execution, influence and delivery role. You do not need to arrive as an AI expert. We are looking for someone with the intellectual curiosity and learning agility to build that knowledge quickly, combined with the judgement, energy and commercial awareness to help translate an evolving strategy into action.

  

Operating as an extension of senior leadership, you will develop a deep understanding of their priorities and help maintain momentum across a broad and sophisticated stakeholder landscape. At times, you will represent senior leaders in meetings and discussions, ensuring their priorities are understood, influencing outcomes and progressing the agenda without requiring their presence in every conversation.

  

You will bring structure to ambiguity, connect activity across different parts of the firm, identify where intervention is needed and ensure priorities continue to move forward at pace. You will be comfortable getting to grips with unfamiliar subject matter quickly and translating complex ideas into clear, practical actions.

  

You will work across legal practice groups, Business Teams, technology, data, knowledge, learning, communications, finance and HR, as well as engaging with external technology providers, clients, regulators and industry partners. The role will also provide exposure to the continued development of Linklaters' Applied Intelligence practice and its client-facing strategy.

  

This is an opportunity to work at the centre of a fast-evolving area, where the technology, operating model and ways of working continue to develop. You will need to be comfortable operating without an established playbook and excited by the opportunity to learn quickly, adapt and help turn an ambitious agenda into tangible outcomes.

  

**About you**

We are looking for someone who combines intellectual curiosity and strong commercial judgement with a genuine bias for action. You will be comfortable working at pace, navigating ambiguity and influencing people without relying on formal authority.

  

You will likely be working within a similar partnership, professional services or consultancy organisation in a transformation, business operations or consulting role and will bring:

  

* A proven ability to turn strategic priorities into action.
* Excellent stakeholder instincts, with the confidence and judgement to engage credibly with senior leaders, understand different perspectives and influence outcomes.
* The ability to represent senior leadership effectively, absorbing their priorities and exercising sound judgement about when to progress matters independently and when to seek their input.
* Strong learning agility and intellectual curiosity, with evidence of getting to grips with unfamiliar or complex subject matter quickly.
* A persuasive and commercially minded communication style, with the ability to simplify complexity, create alignment and move conversations towards action.
* Energy, adaptability and pace, combined with the organisational discipline to keep multiple priorities moving and follow through on commitments.
* Comfort with ambiguity and change, particularly where strategies, technologies and ways of working are still developing.
* A collaborative, low-ego approach, with the confidence to contribute, challenge constructively and learn from those around you.

  

Direct experience of AI is welcome, but it is not essential (and deep technical or engineering expertise is not required).

  

We see this as a role in which the successful candidate will grow and develop, supported by a team that is genuinely invested in building the knowledge, confidence and impact as the AI agenda continues to evolve.

**Technical Skills**

This list of duties and responsibilities above is not exhaustive.  It is intended to describe the general content of, and requirements for, the performance of this job. As such, the role may also include the undertaking of additional tasks as required.

Applications and CVs (direct or via agency) are **only** accepted online via the portal. ## Your Mission

The Role / Role Scope.

  

Linnworks is a fast-growing, international SaaS scale-up, selling to ecommerce brands and retailers across the UK, Europe and North America. Our BDR team is the front door to our pipeline: every inbound demo request and every outbound conversation starts with them.

  

We are looking for a BDR Manager, based in the UK with a global remit, to lead that team and make it the most effective, AI-powered top-of-funnel function in our market. You'll manage inbound and outbound BDRs across the UK and US, partner closely with Sales, Marketing, Partners and RevOps, and own the targets that feed our Account Executives.

  

The traditional SDR model of high-volume activity and generic sequences is breaking. This is not a role for someone who wants to run the playbook they ran last time. You'll be the one who rewrites it: redesigning how our BDRs research, prioritise, personalise and convert, so a small, sharp team generates outsized pipeline across two regions.

  

Responsibilities.

### Lead and Develop a Global Team

You won't just manage activity; you'll build careers. You'll lead inbound and outbound BDRs across the UK and US and turn them into the next generation of Account Executives.

* Hire and Onboard: Recruit, ramp and retain top BDR talent across both regions, with a structured onboarding plan that gets new hires productive fast.
* Coach to a Standard: Run weekly 1:1s, call reviews and skills sessions focused on discovery, objection handling and written outreach.
* One Team, Two Time Zones: Build a consistent culture and operating rhythm across the UK and US, with fair coverage of both markets.

### Make AI the Engine, Not an Add-On

You'll set the bar for how AI is used across our top of funnel, and lead by example.

* Design AI-First Workflows: Embed AI into account research, prioritisation, personalisation, call summaries and follow-up so BDRs spend more time in real conversations.
* Build the Toolkit: Develop and maintain shared prompts, agents and playbooks; test new AI sales tools and decide what earns a place in the stack.
* Raise Capability: Coach every BDR to use AI confidently and well, without letting outreach become generic.
* Measure the Impact: Track what AI changes in speed-to-lead, conversion and output per head, and share what works.

### Own Pipeline Generation

You are accountable for the number. Inbound and outbound both report to you, so you'll balance speed on inbound with precision on outbound.

* Inbound: Own speed-to-lead, qualification standards and handoff quality
* Outbound: Shape territory, account selection and multi-threaded sequences against our ICP in the UK and US.
* Forecast and Report: Set targets, forecast meetings and pipeline, and report performance to Sales and Revenue leadership.

### Improve the GTM Engine

You'll look beyond your own team to make the whole funnel work better.

* Partner with Marketing: Feed back on lead quality, messaging and what prospects are asking about; co-own lead scoring and SLAs.
* Partner with Sales: Agree what a qualified meeting looks like and keep the BDR-to-AE handoff tight.
* Partner with RevOps: Keep CRM and sales engagement data clean, and improve routing, dashboards and process.
* Experiment: Run structured tests on channels, messaging and plays, then scale what wins.

### Your Team

You'll lead a mixed inbound and outbound team across two regions, reporting into Sales leadership.

## What You'll Bring To The Role

Experience

* 2+ years leading SDR/BDR teams in B2B SaaS, with a track record of hitting or beating pipeline targets.
* Experience managing both inbound and outbound motions, ideally across more than one region or time zone.
* A history of hiring, coaching and promoting BDRs into AE or senior roles.
* Hands-on experience as a high-performing BDR or SDR yourself.
* Deep familiarity with CRM and sales engagement tools (HubSpot or Salesforce; Outreach, Salesloft, Apollo or similar).
* Bonus: experience selling to ecommerce brands or knowledge of platforms such as Shopify, BigCommerce or Amazon.

  

Skills & Attributes

* AI-Native: You already use tools like ChatGPT, Claude or AI sales platforms every day, have rolled AI workflows out to a team, and can show the results.
* Forward-Thinking: You spot where the GTM motion is heading and act before the market forces it.
* A Coach First: You get energy from developing people and hold a high bar with empathy.
* Data-Driven: You don't just report on conversion; you explain why it moved and what you'll change.
* Commercially Sharp: You understand how BDR activity turns into revenue and can talk credibly with Sales, Marketing and leadership.
* Clear Communicator: Excellent written and verbal English, comfortable leading across UK and US working styles.

## Why us?

## What Success Looks Like

* First 30 Days: You know every BDR, the funnel data and the stack. You've shadowed calls in both regions and mapped where time and pipeline are lost.
* By 90 Days: You've shipped a refreshed AI-enabled workflow, set clear targets and SLAs with Marketing and Sales, and built a reporting rhythm leadership trusts.
* By 12 Months: The team consistently hits its pipeline targets, output per BDR is measurably higher, and at least one BDR has been promoted.

You'll be measured on qualified meetings and pipeline generated, meeting-to-opportunity conversion, speed-to-lead on inbound, ramp time for new hires, and team retention and progression.

## The Reality of the Role

To be transparent, this isn't a "maintenance" role.

* The Pace: We move fast. You'll need to be comfortable with 80% certainty and 100% action.
* The Ambiguity: AI tooling changes monthly. You'll be writing the playbook while we're playing the game.
* The Hours: Leading a UK and US team means regular late-afternoon and early-evening overlap with US colleagues.
* The Stakeholders: You'll work with high-drive leaders who value directness, data and commercial logic.

# Technical Product Manager, Product Data & Revenue Platforms

## Description

Lyst is a global fashion shopping platform founded in London in 2010 and catering to over 160M shoppers per year. We offer our customers the largest assortment of premium and luxury fashion products in one place, curating pieces from 27,000 of the world's leading brands and stores. In 2025, Lyst joined Zozo, operators of Zozotown, the leading fashion e-commerce platform in Japan. This partnership marks a bold new era for Lyst, as we accelerate our vision and work together to transform the future of fashion shopping through AI and technology.

At Lyst, we obsess over the customer, providing a search and discovery experience which offers inspiration, fulfilment, and personalisation. We believe that fashion is amazing but shopping for fashion often isn't, and we use our technology, data and creativity to bring more joy, greater choice and fewer fails. Our mission is to help fashion shoppers make better decisions and help fashion partners find better audiences as the category-leading destination for every fashion shopper.

**Role**

Product data, and the systems used to transform and enrich it, sit at the heart of how Lyst serves customers and grows revenue. We are looking for a technically strong Product Manager to lead the direction and delivery of the platforms that support our affiliate operations, paid marketing and product-data enrichment.

You will work across two connected missions. The first is helping our commercial teams launch and improve high-value capabilities such as channel integrations, product feeds, conversion and cost data, attribution, reporting and ROAS optimisation. The second is improving the quality, reliability and discoverability of Lyst's product catalogue through internal tooling, product data enrichment, merging and deduplication, leveraging our partnership with our Data Science team in New Zealand.

This is not a conventional consumer-facing Product Manager role. Many requests will arrive with a clear commercial goal and a proposed solution. Your job is to use judgement: move quickly when the problem and solution are well understood; challenge, simplify or productise the request when that will create more value; and make the trade-offs visible when BAU, reliability, technical debt and roadmap work compete for the same capacity.

**What you'll do**

* Own the joined-up roadmap for the Affiliate Operations team, Commercial Enablement and Product-Data Enrichment, with clear outcomes, sequencing and measures of success.
* Turn commercial priorities into well-shaped technical work, partnering with stakeholders who may already have a strong view of the solution.
* Decide when a request should be delivered directly, when assumptions need testing, and when repeated one-off work should become a reusable platform capability.
* Partner with the Engineering Lead and team to clarify scope, dependencies and acceptance criteria, maintain a healthy backlog and improve delivery predictability.
* Lead planning and communication across Paid Marketing, Partnerships, Operations, Data Science and Product & Technology, making trade-offs and capacity constraints explicit.
* Act as the primary Lyst product contact for the NZ-based Data Science team, aligning roadmaps and turning research outputs into secure, observable and supportable production capabilities.
* Define and track outcomes across commercial performance, data quality, platform reliability and operational efficiency.

**What you'll work on**

* **Paid-channel enablement:** product feeds (e.g. for Google Merchant Center), conversion APIs, cost APIs, attribution, reporting and integrations for channels such as Pinterest and Reddit.
* **Reusable commercial capabilities:** common services, data contracts and self-service tooling that reduce duplicated work across channels and campaigns.
* **ROAS and optimisation:** productionising bidding, measurement and optimisation models with the controls, monitoring and feedback loops needed to operate them safely.
* **Partner and affiliate platforms:** partner feed ingestion and validation, merchant tooling and the services that connect catalogue and commercial workflows.
* **Product-data quality:** enrichment, merging, deduplication, entity resolution, taxonomy and measurable improvements to catalogue completeness and coherence.
* **ZOZO collaboration:** joint milestones, experiments, data contracts, technical workshops and clear handovers across time zones.
* **Platform health:** SLAs, observability, runbooks, incident follow-up, peak readiness, BAU and a pragmatic technical roadmap across services such as Minion, Plasma, Merchant Uploader and Affiliate Service.
* **Portfolio management:** an effective intake process, transparent capacity allocation and clear communication of progress, risk and trade-offs.

## Requirements

* Experience in product management for technical, data or platform products; we expect this will usually mean at least four years in relevant roles.
* Experience working on a MarTech team and/or with marketing and commercial stakeholders
* Enough technical depth to work confidently with APIs, schemas, data contracts, ETL or ingestion pipelines, event flows and production systems.
* A track record of turning ambiguous or fragmented stakeholder needs into coherent, deliverable roadmaps without adding process for its own sake.
* Excellent delivery judgement: you can distinguish discovery from execution, define the right level of product work and keep teams moving.
* Experience balancing planned roadmap work with operational demand, technical debt, incidents and reliability improvements.
* Confidence working with commercially accountable stakeholders, including constructively challenging a proposed solution when the evidence supports it.
* Experience working with engineers and data scientists to take models, pipelines or data products from research or prototype into production.
* A practical, low-ego approach. You care about outcomes, dependable delivery and the long-term health of the systems behind them.

## Benefits

+ **Our Ways of Working:** We all come into the office on **Tuesdays** and **Thursdays**, with the option to work remotely or come into the office on the other days. We believe that in person collaboration and community spirit is super important, which is why we spend some of our time in the office and some of our time at home.

The Contact Centre Performance Lead turns operational data into clear priorities that improve customer outcomes, service delivery and cost efficiency across our outsource partner team and the inhouse Support Hub. Key responsibilities include, the contact centre performance, translating insights into practical improvement plans and optimising third-party systems to reduce avoidable contact. The successful candidate will provide actionable reporting to inform the strategic direction of Customer Care and support performance optimisation.  This role requires someone who can work well within a team, but is also self-driven and looking for proactive opportunities for improvement areas

Key Responsibilties

* Forecasting and resource planning: Work with the forecasting and planning manager to validate the planning cycle for the outsource partner team and the Support Hub.  Review forecast accuracy and explain variances to strengthen future plans.
* Operational performance: Monitor real-time contact volumes, resource availability and service performance across all workstreams. Work with operational leaders to adjust plans, prioritise activity and address service risks across the seven-day operation.  Call out risks / opportunities that may impact forecasting and planning levers
* Budget and efficiency: Maintain visibility of resource requirements against budget, highlight emerging pressures and identify sustainable cost-reduction opportunities without compromising customer outcomes.
* Customer journey improvement: Analyse contact drivers, repeat interactions and journey pain points to identify avoidable demand and friction. Translate findings into prioritised recommendations and track the impact of agreed changes.
* Systems optimisation: Maximise the use of third-party systems to improve operational efficiency, reduce inbound contact volumes and support effective resolution.
* Reporting and insight: work with the outsource provider to produce clear, actionable performance reporting that explains results, underlying drivers, risks and recommended actions. Partner with the internal Data team to enhance the outsourcing data footprint to support evidence-based decisions.
* Performance improvement: Work with contact centre leadership to turn insight into improvement plans, with clear actions, ownership and follow-up. Identify where targeted training or communication could address recurring service issues.
* Channel development: Support the transition towards a live channel as the primary customer interaction channel, monitoring take-up, service delivery and customer outcomes.
* Stakeholder partnership: Build effective relationships across the Support Hub, outsource partner team, E-commerce and Data teams to align performance priorities and support the strategic direction of Customer Care.

KPIs and Measures of Success

* Service delivery: Achieve the stated contact centre targets: Voice SLA of 80% of calls answered within 20 seconds; Social SLA of four hours; and Emails/Orbit SLA of 12 hours.
* Resolution and demand reduction: Minimise interactions required to resolve customer enquiries and demonstrate reductions in avoidable contact following process or system improvements.
* Resource and budget control: Maintain resource spend within the agreed budgets, identifying and tracking cost-reduction opportunities.
* Planning effectiveness: Monitor forecast accuracy and alignment of resources to demand, using variance analysis to improve planning and service delivery.
* Channel transition: Demonstrate increased use of the live channel as the primary customer interaction channel while maintaining service standards and effective resolution.
* Improvement impact: Evidence cost savings and operational benefits from performance analysis, process improvements and system optimisation.

* Previous experience of working with both inhouse and outsource partner teams
* Understanding the planning cycle, and the implications of changes in demand / efficiencies has on budget
* Strong analytical capability, with the curiosity to investigate trends, identify root causes and turn complex data into clear, evidence-based recommendations.

* Confidence to constructively challenge established processes and communicate practical recommendations to operational leaders.

**Your Role**

At the heart of global clinical trials, quality is not a checkpoint, it is a discipline that shapes every decision. In this pivotal role, you will serve as a subject matter expert in risk-based quality management, guiding cross-functional study teams to embed quality principles from the earliest stages of clinical trial design through to completion. This is an active, ownership driven position for someone who has lived the realities of clinical trial operations and is ready to lead from within.

You will lead the implementation and continuous improvement of quality processes across the clinical development lifecycle, ensuring that critical data and processes are identified, risks are proactively identified and managed in a proportionate manner, and trials are consistently inspection-ready. Working closely with service providers and international study teams, you will define quality tolerance limits, maintain quality risk management plans, support risk-based monitoring strategies, and co-lead preparation for regulatory authority inspections. You will also lead the investigation of and response to quality issues, driving accountability and continuous improvement across assigned trials.

The role could be based either in the UK or in Poland.

* You hold a degree in medical science, life science, or a related field (a postgraduate qualification is preferred), and bring at least eight years of hands-on experience spanning the full clinical development lifecycle, including trial design, start-up, conduct, analysis, and reporting.

* You have deep expertise in clinical quality risk management, Quality by Design principles, risk-based monitoring, and Good Clinical Practice inspection readiness, with a strong working knowledge of international regulatory requirements and harmonisation guidelines.

* You communicate with clarity and confidence, are skilled at influencing without authority, and can explain complex regulatory and quality topics to both technical and non-technical audiences across all levels of an organisation.
* You are proactive, accountable, and committed to continuous improvement, with the ability to work independently in a complex multinational environment while actively supporting and coaching colleagues.

# Sales Development Representative (Outbound)

## Own the outbound pipeline at a post-Series A fintech that's changing how UK businesses support their people's financial health. Real impact and fast growth.

## **About Mintago**

**One in four UK employees say money worries affect their ability to do their job. We built Mintago to help businesses and their people financially flourish.**

**More than 600 UK businesses already trust us with that mission, including Toni & Guy, the NHS, Armani and Pho. We're post Series A, the fastest-growing employee benefits platform in the UK, and we're looking for exceptional people to grow with us.**

## **The role**

**We're hiring an SDR who can connect with people, build real pipeline and make things happen. You'll own a high volume of inbound leads and help us build outbound, a brand new revenue stream that is central to our next stage of growth.**

**This isn't a volume-and-pass role. Every conversation should add value, and every meeting you book should be one you'd be happy to sit in yourself.**

**It's a demanding role, and we're upfront about that. In return, you'll be part of a fast-growing business at a pivotal moment, with a real say in how our SDR function is built.**

## **Who we're looking for**

**We want a natural conversationalist: charismatic, warm, sharp and tenacious. Someone who genuinely enjoys talking to people and is willing to put the work in every day.**

* **A connector. You build rapport quickly and make prospects feel heard, whether they're an HR Manager or a Finance Director.**
* **Naturally curious. You ask the questions others don't, research properly and connect the dots between what a prospect says and what they actually need.**
* **Conversion-focused. You care about quality, not activity for its own sake. You don't throw things at the wall to see what sticks.**
* **Brilliantly organised. You can manage a busy inbound queue, follow-ups and outbound campaigns without anything slipping through the cracks.**
* **A proper nurturer. You know that not every lead is ready today, and you stay in touch in a way that's useful, not pushy.**
* **Creative. You'll pick up the phone, record a personalised video and find ways to stand out in crowded inboxes.**
* **Self-driven. You own your day, set your own pace and don't need to be managed into activity.**
* **A fantastic experience for every prospect. Whether or not they buy, people should come away thinking well of Mintago.**

## **What you'll be doing**

* **Owning inbound in HubSpot. Work a high volume of leads from LinkedIn, Meta, our website and webinars, with varying levels of intent. Respond fast, run good discovery and qualify MQLs into SALs.**
* **Building outbound. Help us unlock a new revenue stream through cold calling, personalised email, LinkedIn and video. Build ICP lists and enrichment workflows in Clay, and prioritise accounts using intent signals.**
* **Running great discovery. Uncover pain points, challenges and buying stage, and understand exactly why Mintago is relevant to each business.**
* **Nurturing properly. Keep warm leads engaged until the timing is right, with outreach that adds value every time.**
* **Partnering with our Account Executives. Book qualified meetings, brief AEs before every call, and support them through to close.**
* **Selling into HR and Finance. Speak credibly about salary sacrifice, pensions, tax and National Insurance savings to both audiences.**
* **Building your presence on LinkedIn. Post, engage and use video so prospects recognise and trust you before you reach out.**
* **Feeding back to the wider GTM team. Share what you're hearing in the market to sharpen our personas, messaging and campaigns.**
* **Keeping HubSpot clean. Complete, accurate, up-to-date records, every time.**

## **What you'll bring**

**Due to the volume of applications, we're prioritising candidates with:**

* **At least 2 years in a B2B SDR or BDR role, handling a high volume of inbound leads.**
* **Strong outbound experience: cold calling, personalised email and multi-channel campaigns. Proven outbound success will really set you apart.**
* **Experience in a fast-paced, high-growth environment where you've had to figure things out rather than follow a mature playbook.**
* **Experience selling into HR and Finance stakeholders. An HR, benefits, FinTech or B2B SaaS background is a big plus.**
* **A working understanding of tax and National Insurance, or the curiosity to get there quickly.**
* **Confidence qualifying with BANT or GAP selling, and knowing the difference between a curious prospect and a real opportunity.**
* **Hands-on experience with HubSpot and Clay, and genuine excitement about automation and enrichment.**

## **This probably isn't for you if...**

**We'd rather be honest now than waste anyone's time.**

* **You rely on AI-generated emails and think that's good enough.**
* **You prefer to spray and pray rather than qualify properly.**
* **You need a lot of hand-holding to plan and manage your day.**
* **You let a rejection affect your next call.**
* **You're happy for work to be "done" rather than done well.**

## **How we measure success**

* **SALs created: meetings that hold and meet the quality standards agreed with the AE team.**
* **Pipeline value generated: total revenue potential added to the AE pipeline.**
* **MQL to SAL conversion rate: how well you qualify inbound, which shows whether you truly understand our ICP.**

## **Benefits**

* **MacBook Pro work kit, plus a budget to set up your home office**
* **Hybrid and flexible working**
* **Discretionary unlimited leave, plus your birthday off**
* **£300 a year for your own learning and development**
* **Private medical insurance (Vitality), life insurance (MetLife) and a cash plan (Medicash)**
* **Enhanced parental leave that increases with tenure (first level at 9 months, second at 2 years)**
* **Pension matched up to 4% through our salary sacrifice scheme**
* **Cycle to work and electric vehicle schemes**
* **Mobile and technology salary sacrifice**
* **Discounts on groceries, gyms and holidays**

## **Why join Mintago?**

**We're not a perks platform. We help employers care for their people's financial health through pensions, salary sacrifice, financial education and advice. Our product solves a problem that genuinely matters.**

**If you're good at this, you won't be an SDR forever. We're building a sales organisation that rewards performance and develops people into the next stage of their careers. We grow together.**

## **Our hiring process**

**We aim to get back to you within 1–2 working days after each stage, and to complete the process within 2–3 weeks of your first call. We'll keep every active applicant updated throughout. We sometimes receive more applications than we can review, but we try to respond within a week.**

**About the team:**

Our Borrowing (lending) business is growing rapidly across both existing products and with the planned launch of new initiatives. As our lending portfolio grows, our second line of defence Credit Model Validation team is growing with it - and we’re looking for a Credit Model Validation Manager to join us!

Our Credit Model Validation team provides independent oversight and challenge to our model development teams in the first line of defence. We help Monzo grow safely and make sure the models we use are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and deliver good outcomes for our customers. You’ll join our validation squad and provide expert independent validation and oversight across a broad suite of credit models.

This is a generalist role rather than one focused on a particular model type. You’ll work across models used for impairment, capital, stress testing, forecasting and credit decisioning, including IFRS 9 PD, LGD, EAD and economic response models; decision science scorecards and origination PD models; and Net Present Value (NPV) / unit economics models.

Strong data and analytical skills are a must, as is broad expertise in credit risk modelling and model risk management. You’ll have hands-on experience in model validation and/or development within financial services, and be comfortable getting into the data and code to form an independent view across different model types.

**Your day-to-day**

* Leading hands-on independent validation across Monzo’s credit model portfolio - covering models used for IFRS 9 impairment, capital and stress testing, forecasting, credit decisioning and unit economics - and making sure they are fit for purpose, appropriately governed and performing as expected
* Reviewing and challenging key model-led credit risk assessments, including impairment adequacy, ICAAP and stress testing, using independent analysis to assess assumptions, limitations and impacts
* Developing a deep understanding of Monzo’s credit models and how they are used, and using this to provide impactful input and challenge to model developers and users
* Contributing to making model validation more consistent, scalable and technology-enabled - building reusable analytical tools and tests, experimenting with AI-assisted approaches and helping the team embed them safely
* Reviewing ongoing model performance monitoring to ensure our lending models perform within our risk thresholds, and providing support to our first line of defence teams when action is required
* Performing statistical analyses, model replication and challenger work where appropriate to test assumptions, assess performance and strengthen validation conclusions
* Improving and helping to embed our Model Risk Framework, including our policies, standards, model inventory, governance and validation approach. This means making sure we follow up-to-date regulatory expectations and that our processes remain proportionate and relevant as modelling techniques evolve
* Writing clear and impactful model validation reports, and presenting the findings and actions in relevant committees
* Partnering with colleagues in first line of defence credit strategy, modelling and finance teams - and with wider risk teams across Monzo - to support effective model governance and consistent validation standards across the organisation

### **You should apply if you:**

* Have a strong background and practical experience in credit model development and/or validation across a range of model types. You’ll have meaningful experience with IFRS 9 impairment, Internal Ratings Based (IRB) or other capital models, alongside broader exposure to several areas such as stress testing, economic response, forecasting, decision science scorecards or NPV / unit economics modelling
* Understand model risk management in practice, including independent validation, model governance, ongoing monitoring, model change and issue management, and how regulatory expectations apply across the model lifecycle
* Are impact-driven and want to improve how validation is done, not only complete individual reviews. You can turn repeatable work into practical methods, tools or guidance that improve quality and consistency across the team.
* Are curious about AI and automation, and can assess where they add value, the risks they introduce, and the controls and human oversight needed. Experience with AI-assisted analytical or coding tools is useful, but not essential
* Are data driven, with strong analytical skills and deep knowledge of statistical techniques for credit and model risk. Strong SQL and Python skills are essential. You can produce clear, reusable and tested code, using collaborative practices such as version control, peer review and documentation. Experience with Tableau, Looker or similar is a plus.
* Can assess models in the context of how they are used - including accounting, capital, credit strategy, risk appetite and customer outcomes - and can distinguish technical model performance from the wider risks of relying on the model
* Have strong written and verbal communication skills, and are able to articulate problems and solutions using clear and simple language. This is particularly important for breaking down complex issues and priorities to non-experts
* Have a track record of building and maintaining trusting relationships with stakeholders at all levels, and can provide effective and respectful challenge

**Our technology stack**

We rely heavily on the following tools and technologies (note we do not expect applicants to have prior experience of all them):

* Google Cloud Platform for all of our analytics infrastructure

* Python for data science and machine learning
* Go to write our application code

We are committed to providing an excellent client experience while continuing to evolve the way we deliver our services through collaboration, technology and continuous improvement.  
  
The Billing Operations Business Partner plays an important role in supporting both the commercial performance and operational effectiveness of the HR Consultancy team. With responsibility for billing, work-in-progress (WIP) management, debt recovery, reporting and financial governance, the role helps ensure consultancy activity is effectively converted into revenue while maintaining strong financial and operational discipline.  
  
Working closely with the Director of HR Consultancy and wider leadership team, you will act as a trusted business partner, providing commercial insight and operational support, identifying opportunities to improve processes and helping to maximise profitability and cash collection.  
  
Alongside the financial aspects of the position, you will support the effective day-to-day operation of the consultancy, helping to maintain excellent client service, efficient systems and processes, and effective collaboration across the team. This broad remit provides an opportunity to directly contribute to the continued development, efficiency and profitable growth of the HR Consultancy business.  
  
**We offer flexibility around location, with the role able to be based from any** **Moore Kingston Smith office****, on a hybrid basis. However you will be expected to attend our London City office for a monthly team meeting.**

## Key Responsibilities

**Billing, WIP and Financial Management**

* Manage the end-to-end billing process, ensuring invoices are raised accurately, on time and in accordance with agreed client fee arrangements, retainers and project terms.
* Monitor and review work in progress (WIP), identifying opportunities to convert activity into revenue, minimise write-offs and support profitable client delivery.
* Support debt management by tracking outstanding invoices and working with consultants, partners and finance teams to improve collections.
* Lead on billing cases, resolving issues and escalating complex matters where appropriate.
* Produce regular reporting on billing, WIP, debtors, utilisation, recovery and overall team performance.
* Support budgeting, forecasting and revenue planning activities.
* Drive compliance with time-recording requirements and ensure financial information is accurate and kept up to date.
* Provide commercial support and guidance to the Director of HR Consultancy, Head of Reward and HR Business Partners on billing, budgets and financial performance.
* Act as a trusted business partner to the HR Consultancy leadership team, highlighting financial and operational risks, trends and opportunities.

**Client and Service Delivery**

* Manage and take accountability for service delivery to clients, supporting the team in delivering excellent client service.
* Track client service level agreements and ensure agreed deadlines are met.
* Respond to client enquiries in a professional and timely manner.
* Cultivate and manage strong internal and external client relationships, acting as a trusted adviser and primary point of contact.
* Collaborate effectively with colleagues across the consultancy to support the delivery of integrated HR solutions.
* Manage the client onboarding and offboarding process.

**Systems, Data and Process Improvement**

* Ensure relevant systems, including the CRM, are maintained and information is accurate and up to date.
* Maintain a high level of proficiency in relevant software and systems, using technology to streamline activities and improve efficiency.
* Proactively identify and implement opportunities to improve billing, administrative and operational processes, controls and reporting.

**Business and Operational Support**

* Support the Director of HR Consultancy with the day-to-day business operations of the department, including diary management and wider organisational activities.
* Collaborate with Senior HR Business Partners to align operational and strategic goals.  
  Support internal teams in delivering services to clients and contribute to business development activities.
* Support knowledge management and the maintenance of HR Consultancy resources.
* Assist other teams with administrative tasks as required.
* Actively participate in team meetings and wider company initiatives.

## Skills, Knowledge and Expertise

* Strong financial, billing or operational management experience, ideally within a professional services and/or consultancy environment.
* Experience of WIP management, billing and debt recovery processes.
* Strong commercial and operational experience, with an understanding of how effective financial and operational management supports profitable client delivery.
* Excellent analytical and reporting skills, with the ability to interpret financial and operational information, identify trends and provide meaningful insights.
* Strong attention to detail and organisational skills, with the ability to manage multiple priorities, deadlines and competing demands effectively.
* Commercially focused with a proactive, solutions-orientated approach, able to identify issues, opportunities and improvements and take appropriate action.
* Strong communication, stakeholder and relationship management skills, with the confidence to influence and constructively challenge colleagues at different levels.
* Strong client service skills, with the ability to build effective internal and external relationships and take ownership of delivering a responsive, high-quality service.
* Experience of improving processes and ways of working, including identifying opportunities to
* increase efficiency, strengthen controls and make effective use of technology.
* Strong systems and digital skills, including proficiency in Microsoft Office and the ability to confidently use and maintain financial, CRM and other business systems.
* A collaborative and flexible approach, with the ability to work effectively across different teams and support wider operational and business priorities.

# Lead Model Design Engineer – Wind Tunnel Model Development

**Lead the development of wind tunnel models that drive aerodynamic performance in Formula 1.**We’re looking for an experienced **Lead Model Design Engineer** with a background in Formula 1 wind tunnel model development to lead the design, delivery and technical assurance of a key area of our wind tunnel model programme.  
  
Working at the interface between Aerodynamics, Model Design and Manufacturing, you’ll ensure aerodynamic concepts are translated into precise, robust and manufacturable model components, delivered to the quality and timing demanded by a competitive F1 environment.  
  
This is an opportunity to combine deep technical expertise with team leadership, taking ownership of delivery, developing engineering capability and driving continuous improvement in how we design, build and prepare models for testing. Your work will directly influence the quality and efficiency of aerodynamic development as we strive to challenge at the front of the grid.Key Responsibilities

* Own the timing, quality and delivery of your allocated Model Design area, setting priorities and allocating resources to meet programme demands.
* Provide technical leadership and assurance across mechanical design, advanced CAD, design for manufacture and assembly, structural integrity, tolerances and verification.
* Work closely with Manufacturing, Model Build and other engineering functions to resolve design issues, manage non-conformances and remove barriers to delivery.
* Own Model Part Generator capability and priorities across your area, ensuring technical consistency and effective ways of working across Model Design groups.
* Assure configuration management, checking and release processes, including compliance with FIA Restricted Wind Tunnel Testing requirements.
* Drive model quality, test readiness and test efficiency, coordinating responses to significant design-related issues affecting the test programme.
* Act as the principal delivery interface for your area, aligning cross-functional priorities and escalating significant technical, resource and programme risks to the Head of Model Design.
* Lead, coach and develop a high-performing team, setting clear objectives, supporting individual development and promoting accountability, collaboration and the Team Values.

Skills, Knowledge & Expertise

* Engineering degree or equivalent experience, with a proven track record of leading delivery in Formula 1 wind tunnel model design and development.
* Extensive mechanical design experience and advanced 3D CAD capability, ideally including CATIA.
* Strong knowledge of design for manufacture and assembly, materials, manufacturing processes and wind tunnel model build and testing.
* Technical expertise in structural integrity, tolerances, positioning and verification, with the judgement to assure design solutions across a team.
* Experience managing Model Part Generators, alongside robust configuration, checking and release processes, including FIA Restricted Wind Tunnel Testing requirements.
* Established people leadership and resource allocation experience, with the ability to develop technical capability and manage competing priorities.
* Strong problem-solving, communication and stakeholder management skills, balancing safety, quality, delivery, cost and risk in a fast-paced engineering environment.

**Make an impact**  
At Aston Martin Aramco, you’ll help ensure our wind tunnel model development keeps pace with the demands of aerodynamic development. Your technical decisions, leadership and delivery will directly influence how effectively aerodynamic concepts are developed, built and tested.  
  
It’s an opportunity to shape engineering capability, work alongside talented specialists and play a meaningful role in our ambition to challenge at the front of the grid.  
  
If you have the F1 model design experience, technical depth and leadership capability to make a difference, we’d like to hear from you!  
Job BenefitsInvesting in your career is paramount. We promote professional and personal development through a provision of learning opportunities and work with you to shape your career and realise your full potential.  
  
As part of our high-performing, collaborative team, you'll enjoy a competitive package, including a discretionary bonus scheme, private healthcare, pension plan, life assurance, TEDSgroup childcare benefits, a cycle-to-work scheme, tech scheme, and car scheme.  
  
You will also have access to our state-of-the-art facilities at the AMR Technology Campus, featuring a new on-site gym with fitness, spin and yoga classes, a bistro café, and restaurant.

At Nando's, we're on a mission to Create Lasting Happiness, and technology plays a huge part in making that happen.

We're looking for a Software Engineer to join our Commercial Planning & Estate Management (CPEM) team. You'll join a collaborative team where you'll have the freedom to contribute ideas, take ownership of your work and develop your skills alongside people who genuinely enjoy what they do.

## What's the team all about?

Our CPEM team builds and looks after the technology that helps Nando's restaurants run smoothly every day.

We work across several products, each tackling a different challenge:

* **Forecast:** Helping restaurants predict sales and plan food requirements, so they have what they need, when they need it.
* **Hours:** Managing restaurant opening hours and closures, making sure accurate information reaches everything from delivery platforms to customer-facing systems.
* **Restaurant Master Data:** Keeping the information about our restaurants accurate, consistent and available to the systems that rely on it.
* **Access Maintain:** Connecting our estate maintenance platform with our wider data ecosystem to give teams better access to the information they need.

There's plenty of variety here. You'll work across existing products while also having opportunities to get involved in new challenges as the team continues to evolve.

* **Backend:** TypeScript, Node.js and Go
* **Frontend:** React and Svelte
* **Data:** PostgreSQL, Firestore and BigQuery

NETbuilder’s Managed Security Services practice specializes in running and improving security operations for mid-market and enterprise customers using the platforms in which they have already invested.

This is an early-stage opportunity with proven traction. NETbuilder has already onboarded its first fourteen managed security services customers and is now building the sales engine, partner motion, and delivery capacity required to expand that base to hundreds of customers.

We have distinct offerings for our two core markets. Enterprise customers receive tailored, engineering-led services for complex security environments, including co-managed and fully managed operations. Our expertise spans CrowdStrike Next-Gen SIEM, Splunk, and Cisco Security. We deliver holistic security services across detection engineering, telemetry and data-source health, threat intelligence, and 24/7/365 SOC monitoring and incident response.

We offer two primary engagement models:

* **Augmenting existing security operations teams.** We work alongside customers’ internal security teams, restoring valuable time and capacity so they can focus on critical security priorities, actions, and initiatives.
* **Running day-to-day security operations.** We take ownership and accountability for security operations on our customers’ behalf, operating 24/7/365. We improve security posture and data maturity while providing a clear path for service transition when the customer is ready.

We position ourselves as a managed service partner, not simply a managed service vendor: communication-first, engineering-led, and accountable for outcomes.

Are you highly motivated and relentlessly focused on achieving the best outcomes for your customers?

Do you have an inquisitive mindset and a genuine desire to learn in an ever-evolving security landscape?

Are you successful yet humble, with a partner-first, customer-centric approach to creating shared success?

This is a critical, high-impact hire for NETbuilder as we accelerate growth across the United Kingdom. You will build your business by landing new logos, co-selling with our strategic platform and channel partners, and growing existing accounts across our enterprise and mid-market propositions.

You will own opportunities from the first conversation through the initial contract and beyond. You will lead discovery with security leaders, shape engagements alongside our solutions and service delivery teams, and close multi-year recurring-revenue agreements.

This is an individual-contributor sales leadership role reporting directly to the VP of Sales, EMEA. You will work closely with internal stakeholders, including our CISO and Global Head of Managed Services.

* **Hunt for new business.** Build and manage pipeline through outbound prospecting into security and IT leadership teams at mid-market and enterprise organizations.

**You will leave the sales playbook better than you found it.**

Overview of role:

You must have experience working with Logistics/Customs operations across EMEA / MENA (Middle East & North Africa). Please note if you don’t have MENA experience, but have strong EMEA experience, and have strong client facing experience, you will be trained on MENA requirements, as we do have a regional SME in place who will guide you.

In terms of the flow of operations, this role gets to work just after the Distribution team(s) finish packaging and generating documents. It works closely with our Order Fulfilment teams and Customers to confirm details on the shipping documents before releasing the shipment over to the carrier for transit. You will be screening 3-4 shipments a day on average, ensuring all required regulatory or in country documentation and approvals are in place.

Once shipments are in transit you would be responsible for tracking the shipments to their end destination, and liaising with carriers in the event of delays or requests for additional information. At times shipments may be delivered to an intermediate warehousing location, so you will keep a list of inventory/shipments stored in these locations and be able to speak with carriers to arrange delivery to customer sites as required, when notified by the customer or relevant Project team.

You will become a Subject Matter Expert for the MENA region and expected to join Project team calls to offer guidance to internal staff and its customers. When shipments are delivered to customers, the candidate would transact such details into Oracle to close-out the order. ## Technical Estimator – Data Centres & Process Engineering

### Description

To provide technical and commercial estimating support across a broad range of engineered heating, cooling and process applications, with particular responsibility for supporting the continued growth of our Data Centre business.

The role will manage customer enquiries from initial receipt through to the preparation of technically compliant and commercially accurate proposals. This will involve engaging directly with customers, consultants and contractors to understand their requirements, interpreting technical specifications and drawings, identifying missing information, undertaking or coordinating engineering calculations, selecting and sizing appropriate equipment and developing suitable technical solutions.

The role will primarily cover fabricated pressure and storage vessels, including calorifiers, buffer vessels and specialist process vessels, together with heat exchangers, packaged heating and cooling systems, steam, condensate and associated mechanical equipment.

Customers and applications will span Data Centres, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, process engineering and other specialist industrial markets.

Following receipt of an order, the Technical Estimator will also be responsible for preparing a clear and comprehensive handover to Engineering, Design, Project Management, Procurement and Production.

**Person specification:**

* Strong technical aptitude with a good understanding of mechanical or process engineering principles.
* Technically curious and interested in understanding how a customer’s complete system operates rather than simply pricing a schedule.
* Numerate and comfortable undertaking engineering calculations.
* Methodical and accurate when dealing with specifications, calculations and pricing.
* Commercially aware and capable of balancing technical compliance, risk, cost and customer value.
* Confident questioning customers to obtain the information required to develop a solution.
* Able to interpret technical specifications, drawings, schematics and datasheets.
* Capable of identifying technical and commercial risks.
* Comfortable communicating with customers, consultants and engineers.
* Able to explain technical matters clearly to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.
* Able to manage multiple enquiries and competing priorities simultaneously.
* Proactive in obtaining missing information rather than relying on unsupported assumptions.
* Resourceful and willing to seek out the right person or information where required.
* Comfortable working autonomously and taking responsibility for progressing your own workload.
* Collaborative and comfortable working across Sales, Engineering and Manufacturing.
* Willing to take ownership and accountability for your work.
* Self-aware and willing to identify areas where additional knowledge, support or development would be beneficial.
* Computer literate and comfortable using Microsoft Word, Excel, email, internal business systems and electronic technical documentation.

### Essential Skills

Responsible for:

1. Managing technical and commercial enquiries across Data Centres, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, process engineering and other specialist markets.
2. Engaging directly with customers, consultants and contractors to establish their technical requirements, application and intended system operation.
3. Asking appropriate technical questions to identify missing information, clarify specifications and establish the design basis required to prepare an accurate quotation.
4. Reviewing specifications, schedules, datasheets, drawings, schematics and other technical documentation.
5. Identifying technical risks, ambiguities, exclusions and areas requiring further clarification before quotation.
6. Understanding the customer’s application and determining the most appropriate equipment or packaged solution.
7. Undertaking or coordinating engineering calculations required to size and select equipment, including calorifiers, buffer and storage vessels, specialist fabricated vessels, heat exchangers, packaged heating and cooling plant, pumps, valves, controls and associated equipment.
8. Interpreting operating temperatures, pressures, flow rates, heat loads and other relevant process parameters.
9. Understanding how individual components interact within the customer’s wider mechanical or process system.
10. Constructively challenging customer requirements where alternative solutions may improve performance, reliability, manufacturability, programme or value.
11. Producing accurate and commercially robust estimates covering materials, bought-out equipment, fabrication, assembly, testing, certification, documentation and other project requirements.
12. Obtaining and evaluating supplier quotations for specialist components, equipment and services.
13. Considering manufacturing complexity, programme, testing, inspection, certification and project-specific requirements when developing costs.
14. Preparing clear and professional technical and commercial proposals identifying scope, assumptions, exclusions, programme requirements and commercial terms.
15. Identifying opportunities for value engineering and alternative technical proposals where these may improve competitiveness or customer value.
16. Understanding relevant engineering standards, codes and regulatory requirements and recognising where specialist technical or compliance input is required.
17. Ensuring applicable testing, inspection, certification and documentation requirements are identified and included at enquiry stage.
18. Reviewing successful quotations and purchase orders to confirm that the order reflects the agreed technical and commercial scope.
19. Identifying and resolving discrepancies between quotations, specifications, correspondence and purchase orders before projects are released.
20. Preparing accurate order-entry information, bills of materials and supporting technical and commercial information.
21. Preparing comprehensive project handovers covering the agreed design basis, equipment selection, customer requirements, assumptions, exclusions, programme, testing and documentation requirements.
22. Providing clarification and technical support to Engineering, Design, Project Management, Procurement and Production following handover where required.
23. Working closely with the Data Centre Sales Lead and wider Sales team to qualify and prioritise opportunities.
24. Managing your own workload and priorities, taking ownership of progressing enquiries and contributing towards agreed performance measures.
25. Using the considerable technical knowledge available across the business effectively, knowing when to work through an issue independently and when to seek input from experienced colleagues.

### Desirable Skills

Previous experience within mechanical engineering, process engineering, HVAC, pressure equipment, heat transfer, packaged plant or a related engineered-product environment.

Experience or knowledge in several of the following areas would be advantageous:

* Technical estimating, proposals or applications engineering
* Customer-facing technical sales support
* Equipment sizing and selection
* Heat transfer principles and heat exchanger selection
* Pressure vessels and pressure systems
* Fabricated vessels and manufacturing processes
* Packaged heating and cooling plant
* Pumps, valves and associated mechanical equipment
* Steam and condensate systems
* Preparation of technical and commercial quotations
* Engineering standards and regulatory requirements
* Inspection, testing, certification and documentation requirements
* Supplier engagement and evaluation of bought-out equipment and services
* Project or engineering handover

Experience within Data Centres, pharmaceutical, oil & gas, industrial process, critical infrastructure or other technically demanding sectors would also be advantageous, but is not essential where the candidate can demonstrate strong transferable engineering capability.

### Qualifications

A qualification in Mechanical Engineering, Building Services Engineering, Process Engineering or a related discipline would be advantageous.

Equivalent practical engineering experience combined with strong technical knowledge and demonstrable capability will also be considered.

### Salary And Benefits

Competitive salary and benefits package.

Further details to be confirmed.

Bradford. The role will be predominantly Bradford office-based, with scope for flexible and home working where appropriate.

# About the role

This is a senior individual contributor role in our Data Services & Governance team where you'll act as the thought and technical leader owning the semantic layer and analytics standards for Pleo. This means that you won't own a domain but you'll own what good looks like across all of them by developing, improving , maintaining and evangelising our modelling standards and AI-augmented development practices that every Analytics Engineer work with, regardless of which team they sit in.

The semantic layer you will be designing and maintaining will be the single source of truth that AI agents, BI tools, and analysts query. This is foundational work with company-wide reach which will be ideal for you if you enjoy building things from the ground up. Our semantic layer is still in very early stage. Tooling selection is live, and this role has a strong voice in it. Our BI stack is also in transition so, you would not be inheriting a mature setup and maintaining it. You'd be deciding what it should be, then building it.

For additional context, our tech stack currently include: GCP, BigQuery, dbt Core, Airflow, SQL, Python, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot.

# Who you'll work with

You'll report to the Data Engineering Manager who oversees the Data Infra & MLOps team as well as the Data Services & Governance team. Your primary relationship will be with Analytics Engineers embedded across the Intelligence function who should come to you for architecture guidance, semantic layer decisions, and standards questions. You will also partner with a Staff Data Engineer on data engineering standards and pipeline practices, and with others on self-serve analytics and BI tooling governance. You'll engage with the Data Serving team on entity definitions and with the GenAI Platform team on what AI-ready data looks like at the platform boundary.

# What you'll be doing

* Own the semantic layer: define what a metric definition is, how it's structured, where it lives, and how it's enforced. The goal is one canonical definition of Monthly recurring revenue (MRR), churn, transaction, customer - used by analysts, BI tools, and AI tools without divergence. You make that real, not aspirational.
* Set data modelling standards for the function: what clean, layered, well-tested dbt architecture looks like across all domains, at all levels of complexity.
* Build and run the Analytics Engineering community of practice including code reviews, shared patterns, documentation, onboarding etc. The goal is to create a social infrastructure that makes standards stick.
* Own the AI-native development practice. Use AI coding tools as a native part of how you write, review, and migrate data models (not as a demonstration, but as your actual workflow). Evaluate what works in a governed data engineering context, what introduces risk, and shape how the Analytics Engineering community adopts it.
* Lead responsible AI-augmented migration work using AI tooling to accelerate data modelling and migrations across the Analytics Warehouse and Operational Data Platform.
* Design data models and metric definitions in a documented and structured manner enabling reliable consumption by AI services without human intervention.
* Engage upstream with backend and product engineers to drive data contract discipline and schema ownership upstream, rather than managing inconsistency downstream.
* Contribute to Data & AI Products for external customer-facing analytics where data modelling patterns and conversational analytics needs and capabilities grow.

# What you bring

* Deep demonstrated expertise in dbt and modelling practices: not just strong modelling, but a formed view of what modelling architecture should look like across a function. You can defend trade-offs, teach them, and enforce them in teams you don't manage.
* Deep BigQuery and SQL expertise, including performance, cost considerations, and the architectural challenges of complex analytical domains.
* Real experience owning a semantic layer (LookML, dbt MetricFlow, or equivalent). You have a point of view on what metric consistency should look like at scale, what breaks when it doesn't, and how to design it so AI tooling can consume it without degrading trust.
* AI-native development practice in a data engineering context. You use AI coding tools (Claude Code, GitHub Copilot, or equivalent) as a genuine part of how you work, and you can be specific about where they add real value and where they introduce risk in a governed analytics codebase.
* A track record of setting standards across teams you don't directly manage and making them stick by leveraging effective influencing techniques as opposed to relying on authority.
* Understanding of what LLMs and agentic tools need from a data layer such as how to model data, write documentation, and define metrics so that AI tools get consistent answers at runtime.
* Proven experience engaging credibly with backend engineers on data contracts and with senior stakeholders on what the semantic layer strategy means for the business.

# Why this role is a good fit for you

This role is a good fit if:

* You can hold a standard without needing it applied perfectly, and you know which compromises are fatal and which are just untidy.
* You genuinely enjoy growing a community of practice through influence rather than authority and you take pride in seeing colleagues adopt and grow standards.
* You find the "how do we make data legible to an agent, not just to an analyst" problem interesting in its own right, rather than as a trend to keep up with.

This role is not a good fit if

* You want to own a domain. The Intelligence teams have strong AEs doing that. This role is for someone who wants to own the standards they build to.
* You advise others to use AI coding tools but don't use them yourself. AI-native development is part of the mandate, not a differentiating nice-to-have.
* You are more comfortable being consulted than being accountable. The semantic layer and modelling standards you set have downstream consequences across the whole function and in AI features customers use.

# Your first 6 months

By the end of your first six months, you'll have:

* Mapped the current state of modelling standards and the semantic layer across the function (where definitions are consistent, where they diverge, and what the highest-impact gaps are) to draft a plan the function has bought into.
* Contributed to the semantic layer tooling decision and begun onboarding the Analytics Engineers who'll build to it by writing documentation, running live sessions, reviewing PRs etc.
* Established a visible presence in the AE community of practice and become someone whose feedback in code reviews and whose opinions on architecture are listened to because they've been demonstrated, not just stated.
* Run your own workflow on AI coding tooling to the point where you can say clearly what the function should adopt, what it should not, and why.

# The interview process

We want to ensure you are set-up for success and understand what will be expected of you. If your application is successful, our interview process is as follows:

1. Intro call: A 30-minute chat with our Talent Partner to discuss the role and your background.
2. Core skills test: A technical test you'll be taking through an external platform to showcase your grasp of analytics engineering fundamentals.
3. Hiring Manager interview: A 60-minute conversation-based interview aimed at deep diving into your previous experience and learning more about the team.
4. Pleo Challenge: A live practical and technical interview designed to assess your problem solving skills as well as your technical expertise.
5. Final interview: A 45-minutes interview with one of our senior leaders, focusing on assessing behavioural skills and values alignment.

Transparency is important to us so we also wanted to share some insights about what we’re looking for in applications to ensure you can set yourself up for success! With this in mind, we want to help you understand what we really care about when reviewing your application:

* We receive a lot of CVs, and many of them are AI-generated. We love seeing people leverage AI—it’s a big focus for us internally too—but without human intervention, these CVs can sometimes become generic and fail to show a candidate in the best light. What we're really looking for is the specific details of real impact that only you—not AI—know from your previous experience. A top tip from us is to use the “Achieved X, as measured by Y, by doing Z” formula (credit: Laszlo Bock, ~2014) to give a really clear picture of what you’ve worked on. A final note: including links to your previous companies' websites is a huge help and allows us to truly understand your background.
* Every single application we receive is reviewed by a human (yes, hundreds of them) because we believe that candidates' efforts should be matched by an equal level of human care. This means that we expect a similar level of attention put into your application. Read and answer the application questions carefully, they make a huge difference in our decision-making process.
* This is a Staff level role at Pleo. This means it's a very senior position where you need to demonstrate experience leading technical initiatives that can have organisation-wide or cross-team impact for a tech business of 500-1000+ people. Prior experience owning a semantic layer is also a non-negotiable. Make sure your application reflects this.

You will help shape our biological components and workflows into products. That means defining how they are formulated, packaged, stored and specified, and building the evidence that they perform reliably over time.
This is a structured, hands-on lab role, not an exploratory research one. Much of the work is planned, repeated testing on our nanopore platform: stability studies, lot-to-lot comparisons and performance runs, all supported by electrophysiology and analysis of large datasets. It suits someone who likes rigour and consistency, understands what it takes to get a product ready for launch, and wants to help build that capability as we grow.

Plan, run and report stability and shelf-life studies, including real-time, accelerated and in-use studies, and help define storage and shipping conditions.
Help shape the product: formulation, component format, kit configuration, specifications and performance metrics.
Run repeated, well-controlled performance testing on the platform using electrophysiology, including lot-to-lot, robustness and comparability studies.
Analyse and trend large experimental datasets using Python or similar, applying statistics to support product decisions.
Troubleshoot and improve performance, robustness and reproducibility.
Identify what each product will need to launch, including specifications, test methods, stability data and documentation, and help build it within our eQMS.
Write protocols, reports and SOPs, and support method transfer to the Biologics production team.
Work closely with Biologics, platform, engineering, data science and R&D colleagues.

A BSc, MSc or equivalent industry experience in biochemistry, biophysics, molecular biology, proteomics, bioengineering or a related discipline.
Hands-on experience developing, optimising or testing biological or enzymatic products, assays or workflows.
Experience running structured, repeated studies (e.g. stability, robustness or lot comparisons) with careful execution and record-keeping.
Experience analysing larger datasets using Python, R or similar, with a good grounding in statistics.
An understanding of what a biological product needs to be launched and supported, or a strong interest in building that knowledge.
The ability to work independently while contributing well to a multidisciplinary team.
Desirable:
Electrophysiology experience, ideally with nanopore or single-channel recordings.
Experience in product development within a QMS (e.g. ISO 13485, ISO 9001, IVD or life science tools), including specifications, design verification or method transfer.
Experience with formulation, reagent or kit development, or packaging and shipping studies.
Experience with chromatographic techniques (e.g. HPLC/FPLC).

We are looking for an experienced Rust Engineer to join the Proton Drive team.

**Drive Foundation** is the backbone of Proton Drive. • **Architect and develop core libraries:** Lead the design and development of core Rust libraries that serve as the backbone for Proton web and mobile applications.

**What We Offer**

Our Mission
Reflection is a research lab making intelligence open and accessible for everyone to use, customize, and build on. We build open models that let anyone control their intelligence and help shape the future of AI. Our mission: make intelligence open and accessible to all.
About the Role
Reflection's Data team builds the training corpora our frontier models learn from. Before a model can learn anything, the data has to be found, fetched, extracted, and delivered reliably, responsibly, and at enormous scale. The ingestion layer is the machinery that turns the open web, licensed corpora, and other large-scale sources into well-structured, versioned, auditable datasets for pre-training.
As Data Acquisition Lead, you'll provide front-line leadership of the team that builds this layer, spanning all three of its pillars web crawl, data ingestion pipelines, and data lakes. You'll build, mentor, and grow a team of data ingestion engineers, guide the technical and architectural decisions across crawling, extraction, and corpus storage/delivery, and work closely with the pre-training research, data quality, and data partnerships teams that depend on what you ship. You'll stay close enough to the stack to make targeted contributions as an individual contributor and to maintain a deep understanding of the team's technical work. Subtle decisions at the ingestion layer what we crawl, how we extract, what we keep ripple through training and directly affect where our models are strong, safe, and where they fail.
What You'll Do
Build, mentor, and grow a high-performing team of data ingestion engineers. Coach and support your reports in understanding, and pursuing, their professional growth.
Provide front-line leadership across the full ingestion stack — web crawling and acquisition, extraction and normalization pipelines, and the data lakes that version and deliver training corpora and the campaigns that run across all three.
Stay hands-on: become familiar with the team's technical stack enough to make targeted contributions as an individual contributor.
Manage day-to-day execution: prioritize the team's work and run data acquisition and ingestion campaigns in a highly dynamic, fast-paced environment.
Guide technical and architectural decisions, emphasizing scalability, reliability, auditability, and cost crawler architecture and politeness/scheduling, distributed processing (Ray/Beam/Spark), orchestration (Airflow/Prefect), storage formats and layout (Parquet, JSONL, WARC; object stores and lakehouse formats), deduplication, and dataset versioning and delivery.
Close the loop with research: partner with pre-training and data quality teams to tie ingestion decisions to measurable downstream model impact, and run experiments to evaluate crawling strategies, extraction methods, and ingestion tradeoffs.
Work across the wider data effort data partnerships, digitization operations, and external vendors to onboard new sources within legal, licensing, and robots.txt constraints.
Raise the bar for technical judgment, prioritization, communication, and execution in a fast-moving environment.
What We're Looking For
Experience building, mentoring, and growing data or infrastructure engineering teams while staying technically hands-on. (Comfortable growing into leading a larger team quickly if you haven't managed at that scale before.)
Deep experience building web-scale data acquisition or ingestion systems, with real ownership of production-grade pipelines at multi-TB to PB scale.
Strong coding ability and the credibility to earn the technical trust of a strong team.
Deep expertise in at least one of: web crawling & acquisition, large-scale extraction & ingestion pipelines, or data lakes / corpus storage & delivery with working knowledge across the others, and the ability to learn the rest.
Fluency with the modern large-scale data toolkit: distributed compute (Ray, Beam, Spark), orchestration (Airflow, Prefect), formats (Parquet, JSONL, WARC), and object-store / data-lake architectures.
Familiarity with how LLMs are trained and evaluated, and an intuition for what makes data useful for training; comfortable designing experiments and using proxy quality signals to guide system improvements.
Ability to guide strategy and drive execution across concurrent data campaigns, and to partner effectively with research teams, external data vendors, and partnerships/legal on acquisition.

We believe that to make intelligence open and accessible to all, you need to start at the foundation. Joining Reflection means building from the ground up as part of a talent-dense team. You will help define our future as a company, and help define the future of open foundational models.
We want you to do the most impactful work of your career with the confidence that you and the people you care about most are supported.
